title: Open Energy Ontology (OEO)
description: Domain ontology for energy system modelling and analysis, built on the Basic Formal Ontology (BFO) and parts of the Common Core Ontologies. It covers the physical energy system (power plants, power generating units, energy converting components, energy storage objects, supply grids and their components, energy carriers and fuels), quantities and units, and the information side of energy system research (models, scenarios, data sets, studies). It is the reference vocabulary of the Open Energy Platform.
publisher: Open Energy Family / Open Energy Platform community (OEO maintainers, incl. contributors from Reiner Lemoine Institut, Öko-Institut, DLR, OVGU Magdeburg and others); published at openenergyplatform.org

models.name: EnergyStorageObject
models.title: Smart Data Models - Open Energy Ontology - EnergyStorageObject
models.description: An energy storage object is an artificial object that has the function energy storage (oeo:OEO_00000159 'energy storage object', Open Energy Ontology v2.14.0, definition verbatim). Modelled generically: the specific OEO subclass (lithium-ion battery, flow battery, sensible heat storage object, underground hydrogen storage object, ...) is carried in oeoClass. Note that OEO classifies pumped hydro storage as a power plant (pumped hydro storage power plant), not as an energy storage object; use PowerPlant for those.

models.name: GridComponent
models.title: Smart Data Models - Open Energy Ontology - GridComponent
models.description: A grid component is an energy transformation unit that is a discrete part of a supply grid serving a specific purpose. A grid component is defined by having a grid component role (oeo:OEO_00020006 'grid component', Open Energy Ontology v2.14.0, definition verbatim). Modelled generically: the specific OEO subclass (grid node, switchyard, transformer, AC-line, HVDC-line, vehicle charging station, ...) is carried in oeoClass.

models.name: PowerGeneratingUnit
models.title: Smart Data Models - Open Energy Ontology - PowerGeneratingUnit
models.description: A power generating unit is an energy transformation unit that has the function to produce electrical energy (oeo:OEO_00000334 'power generating unit', Open Energy Ontology v2.14.0, definition verbatim; German 'Kraftwerksblock'). Modelled generically: the specific OEO subclass (gas fired power unit, lignite power unit, wind energy converting unit, PV panel, ...) is carried in oeoClass.

models.name: PowerPlant
models.title: Smart Data Models - Open Energy Ontology - PowerPlant
models.description: A power plant is an energy transformation unit consisting of power generating units and a grid component that feeds electric energy into an electric grid (oeo:OEO_00000031 'power plant', Open Energy Ontology v2.14.0, definition verbatim). Modelled generically: the specific OEO subclass (coal, gas, wind farm, pumped hydro storage power plant, ...) is carried in oeoClass rather than as 37 separate entity types.

models.name: SupplyGrid
models.title: Smart Data Models - Open Energy Ontology - SupplyGrid
models.description: A supply grid is a supply system of systematically connected artificial objects that can work as a supply system (oeo:OEO_00000200 'supply grid', Open Energy Ontology v2.14.0, definition verbatim; also 'grid', 'network'). Modelled generically: the specific OEO subclass (electricity grid, transmission grid, distribution grid, gas grid, heating grid, control area) is carried in oeoClass.

title: Open Mining Format (OMF)
description: The Open Mining Format (OMF) is an open file format and library, backed by the Global Mining Guidelines Group, for exchanging 3D geoscience and mining data between applications (geological modelling, mine planning, resource estimation). An OMF file holds a project with a list of elements; each element has one geometry (point set, line set, triangulated surface, grid surface, block model with optional regular, octree or free-form sub-blocks, or a composite of other elements) and a list of attributes attached to its vertices, primitives, sub-blocks or sub-elements (numbers, dates, vectors, text, categories with sub-attributes, booleans, colors and textures). OMF 2 stores a gzip-compressed JSON index, specified by a JSON Schema, plus the bulk arrays as Apache Parquet files and images as PNG/JPEG, all in one ZIP archive.
publisher: Global Mining Guidelines Group (GMG)

models.name: Attribute
models.title: Smart Data Models - Open Mining Format - Attribute
models.description: Describes data attached to an Element. Each Element can have zero or more attributes, each attached to different parts of the element and each containing different types of data. On a set of points, one attribute might contain gold assay results and another rock-type classifications. (OMF 2.0-beta.1 JSON index (omf.schema.json, GMG omf-rust); field names kept verbatim; OMF 'location' renamed omfLocation.)

models.name: Element
models.title: Smart Data Models - Open Mining Format - Element
models.description: Defines a single "object" or "shape" within the OMF file. Each shape has a name plus other optional metadata, a "geometry" that describes a point-set, surface, etc., and a list of attributes that that exist on that geometry. (OMF 2.0-beta.1 JSON index (omf.schema.json, GMG omf-rust); field names kept verbatim; the attributes are separate Attribute entities.)

models.name: Project
models.title: Smart Data Models - Open Mining Format - Project
models.description: Root object of an OMF file. This is the root element of an OMF file, holding global metadata and a list of Elements that describe the objects or shapes within the file. (OMF 2.0-beta.1 JSON index (omf.schema.json, GMG omf-rust); field names kept verbatim; the elements are separate Element entities.)

title: PMD Core Ontology (PMDco)
description: The Platform MaterialDigital Core Ontology (PMDco) is a mid-level ontology for materials science and engineering, built on the Basic Formal Ontology (BFO) and reusing RO, IAO, OBI and COB. It follows the processing - structure - properties paradigm: manufacturing, characterisation (assay) and simulation processes; materials, portions of matter, objects and devices; and material properties and qualities with their value specifications. It is the common semantic basis of the German MaterialDigital initiative and of its application ontologies (tensile test, hardness test, ...). Release 3.1.2 (full) has 1,426 classes (1,191 in the PMDco namespace), 112 object properties and 9 datatype properties.
publisher: Plattform MaterialDigital (PMD), with the PMDco editorial team (BAM, Fraunhofer and partner institutions)

models.name: Assay
models.title: Smart Data Models - PMD Core Ontology - Assay
models.description: A planned process that has the objective to produce information about a material entity (the evaluant) by examining it. (PMD Core Ontology 3.1.2 class 'assay', http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0000070. Entity type and attribute names are the PascalCase / camelCase forms of the English rdfs:labels; context.jsonld maps them to the PMDco, BFO, RO, IAO and OBI IRIs.)

models.name: Device
models.title: Smart Data Models - PMD Core Ontology - Device
models.description: A device is an object that is designed to perform a specific function or task involving measurement, manipulation, processing, or analysis. (PMD Core Ontology 3.1.2 class 'device', https://w3id.org/pmd/co/PMD_0000602. Entity type and attribute names are the PascalCase / camelCase forms of the English rdfs:labels; context.jsonld maps them to the PMDco, BFO, RO, IAO and OBI IRIs.)

models.name: ManufacturingProcess
models.title: Smart Data Models - PMD Core Ontology - ManufacturingProcess
models.description: A planned process that is driven by the primary intent to transform objects A manufacturing process is always a transformative process. (PMD Core Ontology 3.1.2 class 'manufacturing process', https://w3id.org/pmd/co/PMD_0000833. Entity type and attribute names are the PascalCase / camelCase forms of the English rdfs:labels; context.jsonld maps them to the PMDco, BFO, RO, IAO and OBI IRIs.)

models.name: Material
models.title: Smart Data Models - PMD Core Ontology - Material
models.description: A material is a portion of matter that may participate in some manufacturing process and whose shape is not relevant for its participation in the manufacturing process. (PMD Core Ontology 3.1.2 class 'material', https://w3id.org/pmd/co/PMD_0000000. Entity type and attribute names are the PascalCase / camelCase forms of the English rdfs:labels; context.jsonld maps them to the PMDco, BFO, RO, IAO and OBI IRIs.)

models.name: MeasurementDatum
models.title: Smart Data Models - PMD Core Ontology - MeasurementDatum
models.description: A measurement datum is an information content entity that is a recording of the output of a measurement such as produced by a device. (PMD Core Ontology 3.1.2 class 'measurement datum', http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000109. Entity type and attribute names are the PascalCase / camelCase forms of the English rdfs:labels; context.jsonld maps them to the PMDco, BFO, RO, IAO and OBI IRIs.)

models.name: Object
models.title: Smart Data Models - PMD Core Ontology - Object
models.description: (Elucidation) An object is a material entity which manifests causal unity & is of a type instances of which are maximal relative to the sort of causal unity manifested (PMD Core Ontology 3.1.2 class 'object', http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_0000030. Entity type and attribute names are the PascalCase / camelCase forms of the English rdfs:labels; context.jsonld maps them to the PMDco, BFO, RO, IAO and OBI IRIs.)

title: Project Haystack
description: Project Haystack is an open-source ontology and tagging convention for building and IoT data: sites, spaces, equipment, data points (sensors, commands, setpoints), systems, devices, networks and weather stations, described by marker tags (ahu, vav, discharge, air, temp, sensor, ...), value tags and Ref tags (siteRef, equipRef, spaceRef, ...). Haystack 4 defines these as "defs" grouped in the libraries ph, phScience, phIoT and phIct (719 defs in version 4.0.0) and publishes an RDF export. Haystack 5 (Xeto) gives the same entities PascalCase spec names (ph::Site, ph::Equip, ph::Point, ...), which are used here as model names.
publisher: Project Haystack (Project-Haystack Corp. and community)

models.name: Device
models.title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - Device
models.description: Microprocessor based hardware device. This is the general term for all computers, mobile phones, controllers, and I/O modules. See the Haystack 'Devices' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'device', Xeto spec ph::Device. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

models.name: Equip
models.title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - Equip
models.description: Equipment asset. See the Haystack 'Equips' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'equip', Xeto spec ph::Equip. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

models.name: Network
models.title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - Network
models.description: Logical communications network between two or more devices. See the Haystack 'Devices' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'network', Xeto spec ph::Network. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

models.name: Point
models.title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - Point
models.description: Data point such as a sensor or actuator. See the Haystack 'Points' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'point', Xeto spec ph::Point. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

models.name: Site
models.title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - Site
models.description: Site is a geographic location of the built environment. Typically site maps to one building with its own unique street address. See the Haystack 'Sites' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'site', Xeto spec ph::Site. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

models.name: Space
models.title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - Space
models.description: Space is a three-dimensional volume in the built environment. See the Haystack 'Spaces' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'space', Xeto spec ph::Space. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

models.name: System
models.title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - System
models.description: Grouping of related equipment dedicated to a single application. See the Haystack 'Systems' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'system', Xeto spec ph::System. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

models.name: WeatherStation
models.title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - WeatherStation
models.description: Logical weather station and its measurement points. See the Haystack 'Weather' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'weatherStation', Xeto spec ph::WeatherStation. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

title: RealEstateCore (REC)
description: Domain ontology for the real estate and smart buildings industry. It covers the spatial hierarchy of property (Region, Site, Building, Level, Room, Zone), building elements, assets placed in buildings (furniture, ICT and sensor equipment), administrative collections (real estate, portfolio, premises, apartment, campus), agents (organizations, persons), and events (leases, warranties, point observations). Since v4 it is co-designed with Brick Schema: Brick supplies the equipment and point taxonomy, and REC supplies the real estate and location layer. Brick has deprecated its own Location classes in favour of REC's.
publisher: RealEstateCore Consortium (originally Swedish real estate owners and Idun, Willow, Microsoft and others); published at realestatecore.io

models.name: Asset
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Asset
models.description: Something which is placed inside of a building, but is not an integral part of that building's structure; e.g., furniture, equipment, systems, etc. (rec:Asset, RealEstateCore 4.1, definition verbatim). Modelled generically: the specific REC asset class (Desk, Chair, IAQSensorEquipment, NetworkRouter, Door, Window, ...) is carried in recClass. Brick equipment classes (brick:Equipment and its ~220 subclasses, which REC places under Asset) are covered by the brick-schema candidate's Equipment model instead.

models.name: Building
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Building
models.description: A confined building structure (rec:Building, RealEstateCore 4.1, definition verbatim). Specific building types (Hospital, School, ShoppingMall, Stadium, VirtualBuilding) are carried in recClass.

models.name: BuildingElement
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - BuildingElement
models.description: A part that constitutes a piece of a building's structural makeup. E.g., Facade, Wall, Slab, Roof, etc. (rec:BuildingElement, RealEstateCore 4.1, definition verbatim). The element type is carried in recClass.

models.name: Collection
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Collection
models.description: An administrative grouping of entities that are addressed and treated as a unit for some purpose (rec:Collection, RealEstateCore 4.1). The specific collection (Apartment, Campus, Portfolio, Premises, RealEstate, EquipmentCollection, FurnitureCollection) is carried in recClass. Brick collection classes that REC places under Collection are covered by the brick-schema candidate's Collection model.

models.name: Lease
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Lease
models.description: A lease of some leasable object such as a property or a piece of equipment (rec:Lease, an rec:Event, RealEstateCore 4.1; REC gives no definition of its own). Temporal extent comes from start/end.

models.name: Level
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Level
models.description: The level of a building, a.k.a. storey, floor, etc. (rec:Level, RealEstateCore 4.1, definition verbatim). BasementLevel, MezzanineLevel and RoofLevel are carried in recClass.

models.name: Organization
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Organization
models.description: An organization of any sort (e.g., a business, association, project, consortium, tribe, etc.) (rec:Organization, RealEstateCore 4.1, definition verbatim). Company and Department are carried in recClass.

models.name: Room
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Room
models.description: A room within a building (rec:Room, RealEstateCore 4.1; REC gives no definition of its own). Modelled generically: the specific room type -- 95 classes such as Office, ConferenceRoom, CookingRoom, Bedroom, Lobby, OperatingRoom -- is carried in recClass rather than as 95 separate entity types.

models.name: Site
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Site
models.description: A piece of land upon which zero or more buildings may be situated (rec:Site, RealEstateCore 4.1, definition verbatim). Hierarchy: Site -> Architecture -> Space.

models.name: Zone
models.title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Zone
models.description: A sub-zone within or outside of a building defined to support some technology and/or use, e.g., an HVAC zone, a parking space, a security zone, etc. (rec:Zone, RealEstateCore 4.1, definition verbatim). Zone types (HVACZone, OccupancyZone, AccessControlZone, ParkingSpace, Workspace) are carried in recClass.

title: SAREF4AGRI
description: SAREF4AGRI is an extension of the ETSI SAREF (Smart Applications REFerence) ontology for the agriculture and food chain domain, developed by ETSI SmartM2M (originally STF 534, revised under STF 641) and published as ETSI TS 103 410-6. It connects SAREF's generic Device/Sensor/Actuator and FeatureOfInterest/Property/Observation patterns with existing standardization efforts in the AgriFood domain (ICAR for livestock data, AEF for agricultural equipment, the Plant Ontology, AgGateway), reusing W3C SSN/SOSA (System, Deployment, Platform), GeoSPARQL (Feature, Geometry, sfContains/sfWithin topology), the TIME ontology (temporal intervals for deployments), the TAXRANK taxonomy vocabulary (animal/crop species classification) and FOAF (Person/Organization) vocabularies. The ontology is illustrated in the normative TS through two worked examples: livestock farming (farm, farm holding, farmer, animals, animal groups, parcels, crops, milking/eating-activity sensors) and smart irrigation (deployments, platforms, soil tensiometers, pluviometers). This candidate translates the full v2.1.1 class list (21 classes) plus the ten saref:Property named individuals it defines (AirTemperature, AmbientHumidity, Area, Intake, IrrigationWater, PlantGrowthStage, Precipitation, SoilMoisture, SoilTemperature, Yield) into one candidate model per class under models/.
publisher: ETSI

models.name: Animal
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Animal
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Animal. An individual and identifiable living organism that feeds on organic matter, typically having specialized sense organs and nervous system and able to respond rapidly to stimuli. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (SAREF core class, not modeled here); animals and animal groups are related to measurements via the saref:FeatureOfInterest concept of SAREF. Animals can be further specialized using subclasses, e.g. a lactating cow created as a subclass of Animal (ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.2.4/4.3.1 example, not part of the base ontology). NOTE: dataModel.Agrifood (the official Smart Data Models AgriFood subject) already publishes its own distinct entity also named 'Animal'; naming is kept verbatim from the ontology per translation rules, so this is a known name collision to resolve during Candidates review.

models.name: AnimalGroup
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - AnimalGroup
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/AnimalGroup. A collection of one or multiple animals, used to conduct experiments and observations on the livestock. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (SAREF core class, not modeled here). See e.g. ex:Cow_Group_A / ex:Cow_Group_B in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figures 7-8.

models.name: Crop
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Crop
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Crop. A collection of cultivated plants that is grown on a large scale commercially, especially a cereal, fruit, or vegetable. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (SAREF core class, not modeled here). A Crop is grown on some Parcel (geo:sfContains, from the Parcel side) and is related to measurements via saref:FeatureOfInterest. NOTE: the official dataModel.Agrifood subject publishes a conceptually similar but differently-named 'AgriCrop' entity.

models.name: Deployment
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Deployment
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Deployment. The scenario, including temporal and spatial information, in which the systems and devices are installed. Subclass of ssn:Deployment (W3C SSN, not modeled here). Represents a specific installation of a given agricultural system (e.g. a smart irrigation system) on a sosa:Platform for a given time period and at a given geographical location. See the ex:ArvalisDeployment20162017Land07 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2, Figure 9.

models.name: EatingActivitySensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - EatingActivitySensor
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/EatingActivitySensor. Eating activity sensor. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. See the ex:Cow_Eating_Activity_Sensor_33 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 8: two eating-activity measurements of the ex:Cow3 are reported, each measured in time:minute. The example's 'observes'/isValueOfProperty' target in the published figure is annotated ex:MilkYield, which appears to be a documentation artifact (MilkYield fits a MilkingSensor, not an eating-activity measurement); this model instead maps EatingActivitySensor to the s4agri:Intake named individual ('the amount of food or other substance taken into the body of an animal'), the semantically fitting property for this sensor -- an explicit modeling assumption, called out here.

models.name: Farm
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Farm
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Farm. A plot of land used for the scope of farming which can contain buildings and parcels. Subclass of geo:Feature (GeoSPARQL, not modeled here); as a geo:Feature, a Farm inherits the possibility of a physical geometric description via geo:Geometry, exposed here as the NGSI-LD 'location' GeoProperty. See the ex:Farm_Jansen_and_Son_Eindhoven example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 6. NOTE: the official dataModel.Agrifood subject publishes a conceptually similar but differently-named 'AgriFarm' entity.

models.name: FarmHolding
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - FarmHolding
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/FarmHolding. A class to describe a SAREF4AGRI farm holding as a subclass of foaf:Organization (FOAF vocabulary, not modeled here). See the ex:Jansen_and_Sons example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 6: the FarmHolding has Farmer members and manages a Farm.

models.name: Farmer
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Farmer
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Farmer. A class to describe a SAREF4AGRI farmer as a subclass of foaf:Person (FOAF vocabulary, not modeled here). See the ex:J._Jansen / ex:H._Jansen example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 6: both are Farmer instances, members (foaf:member, reused here as the generic s4agri:isMemberOf relation in the example) of the FarmHolding ex:Jansen_and_Sons, which manages the Farm ex:Farm_Jansen_and_Son_Eindhoven.

models.name: MilkingSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - MilkingSensor
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/MilkingSensor. A class to describe an animal milking sensor. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. See the ex:MilkYieldSensor example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 7: the sensor is contained in (saref:consistsOf) an ex:Milking_Machine, measures (saref:isValueOfProperty) ex:MilkYield (a worked-example subclass of s4agri:Yield, illustrating that Yield 'can further be specialized in subclasses, such as MilkYield, CropYield, MeatYield, etc.', per clause 4.2.6) and is measured in om:liter.

models.name: MovementActivitySensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - MovementActivitySensor
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/MovementActivitySensor. A class to describe a motion sensor. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. NOTE: the SAREF4AGRI v2.1.1 ontology does not declare a dedicated saref4agri:Property named individual for 'movement'/'activity level' (unlike Precipitation, SoilMoisture, etc.); 'observes' is therefore left as free text rather than constrained to the ten declared named individuals. NOTE: the official dataModel.Agrifood subject publishes a conceptually related but differently-named 'AnimalMovement' entity.

models.name: Parcel
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Parcel
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Parcel. An area of land, which might be used for grazing animals or planting crops. The parcel is defined as an undividable logical area of land which contains homogeneous items. Subclass of geo:Feature (GeoSPARQL, not modeled here); as a geo:Feature, a Parcel inherits the possibility of a physical geometric description via geo:Geometry (ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.2.7), exposed here as the NGSI-LD 'location' GeoProperty. NOTE: the official dataModel.Agrifood subject publishes a conceptually similar but differently-named 'AgriParcel' entity.

models.name: Platform
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Platform
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Platform. A Platform is an entity that hosts other entities, particularly Sensors, Actuators, Samplers, and other Platforms (definition taken from sosa:Platform). Subclass of sosa:Platform (W3C SOSA, not modeled here). See the ex:ArvalisLand07 platform example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2, Figure 9, which hosts the ex:ArvalisIrrinovStation01 system.

models.name: Pluviometer
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Pluviometer
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Pluviometer. A sensor that measures the rain fall. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here). The ttl declares no own owl:Restriction beyond the subclassing; per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent, the generic saref:Sensor vocabulary it inherits (saref:measuresProperty, saref:hasValue, saref:makesMeasurement, saref:hasFunction, etc.) is documented here rather than repeated structurally. `observes`, `value`, `unitCode` and `dateObserved` are added as common Smart Data Models sensor-observation convenience attributes (not individually declared as their own owl:Restriction on Pluviometer), following the saref:observes / saref:hasValue / saref:isMeasuredIn pattern shown for other SAREF4AGRI sensors in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2.

models.name: Soil
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Soil
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Soil. Upper layer of the earth in which plants grow. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (SAREF core class, not modeled here); the ontology declares no further own owl:Restriction for Soil beyond this subclassing. Soil-related measurements (e.g. soil moisture, soil temperature, captured by SoilTensiometer/Thermometer observations) are produced against this entity as their saref:FeatureOfInterest, not stored directly on the Soil entity itself. NOTE: the official dataModel.Agrifood subject publishes a conceptually similar but differently-named 'AgriSoil' entity.

models.name: SoilTensiometer
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - SoilTensiometer
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/SoilTensiometer. A sensor that measures the soil moisture. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary (saref:measuresProperty, saref:hasValue, etc.) is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. See the ex:ArvalisIrrinovStation01SoilSensor02 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2, Figure 9: this SoilTensiometer observes SoilMoisture with a measured value of 1 490,0 (om:millibar).

models.name: Thermometer
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Thermometer
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Thermometer. A class to describe a sensor that measures temperature. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. SAREF4AGRI defines two specializations of saref:Temperature relevant to this sensor (skos:broader, ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.2.6, Figure 3): s4agri:AirTemperature and s4agri:SoilTemperature.

models.name: WateringGun
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - WateringGun
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/WateringGun. An actuator to irrigate a space. Subclass of saref:Actuator (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Actuator vocabulary (saref:actsUpon, saref:hasState, saref:makesActuation, etc.) is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent.

models.name: WateringSystem
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - WateringSystem
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/WateringSystem. A class to describe a system that dispenses or irrigates water. Subclass of ssn:System (W3C SSN, not modeled here); inherited ssn:System vocabulary (ssn:implements, generic composition semantics) is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. See the ex:ArvalisIrrinovStation01 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2, Figure 9, which has sub-systems (ssn:hasSubSystem) including SoilTensiometer sensors.

models.name: WateringValve
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - WateringValve
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/WateringValve. A class to describe an actuator for dispensing water. Subclass of saref:Actuator (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Actuator vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent.

models.name: WeatherStation
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - WeatherStation
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/WeatherStation. A sensor or system that measures weather conditions. Dual subclass of ssn:System and saref:Sensor (W3C SSN / SAREF core, not modeled here); as a ssn:System it can itself compose sub-sensors (ssn:hasSubSystem), and as a saref:Sensor it can directly report observations. Inherited vocabulary from both parent classes is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. Convenience numeric attributes are exposed for the weather-related s4agri:Property named individuals a weather station typically aggregates (ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.2.6): s4agri:AirTemperature, s4agri:AmbientHumidity and s4agri:Precipitation.

models.name: WeightSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - WeightSensor
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/WeightSensor. A class to describe a sensor that measures mass. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. NOTE: the SAREF4AGRI v2.1.1 ontology does not declare a dedicated saref4agri:Property named individual for 'weight'/'mass'; 'observes' is therefore left as free text rather than constrained to the ten declared named individuals. A weight sensor may weigh livestock (body mass) or harvested produce (yield mass).

title: SAREF4AUTO: an extension of SAREF for the automotive domain
description: SAREF4AUTO extends the SAREF (Smart Applications REFerence) core ontology for the connected and automated vehicles (C-ITS) domain. It models automotive entities (vehicles, trailers, dangerous goods, platoons, vulnerable road users and their clusters, parking spots), roadside infrastructure (road side units, actuators, sensors, traffic light controllers, traffic management centres), a broad catalogue of roadside/ vehicle sensor kinds, and a large controlled vocabulary of traffic event causes -- largely adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 (ITS Common Data Dictionary, CDD) and the Collective Perception / VRU Awareness / Platooning work of ETSI TC ITS and the C-ROADS / ENSEMBLE projects.
publisher: ETSI (European Telecommunications Standards Institute)

models.name: AcousticSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - AcousticSensor
models.description: The class of acoustic sensors (s4auto:AcousticSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: AutomotiveDevice
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - AutomotiveDevice
models.description: A device used to wirelessly communicate with other devices for safety and mobility purposes (s4auto:AutomotiveDevice, subclass of s4auto:AutomotiveEntity).

models.name: AutomotiveEntity
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - AutomotiveEntity
models.description: The main objects of interest in the automotive domain (s4auto:AutomotiveEntity). A generic automotive object exposing the position, shape, kinematic and environmental properties shared by vehicles, traffic participants, vulnerable road users, roadside equipment and other automotive objects in SAREF4AUTO. More specific SAREF4AUTO entities (Vehicle, TrafficParticipant, VulnerableRoadUser, RoadSideUnit, etc.) conceptually extend this generic type and repeat these common properties directly, since NGSI-LD has no formal entity-type inheritance.

models.name: ClusterBreakup
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - ClusterBreakup
models.description: Describes the act of a VRU leader carrying out a procedure to break up a VRU cluster (s4auto:ClusterBreakup, subclass of saref:ProcedureExecution). Linked to the cluster via saref:targets; saref:resultTime indicates the time of breakup and saref:hasResult the reason.

models.name: ClusterJoin
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - ClusterJoin
models.description: Describes the act of a VRU carrying out a procedure to join a VRU cluster (s4auto:ClusterJoin, subclass of saref:ProcedureExecution). Linked to the joining VRU (saref:madeBy) and the VRU cluster (saref:targets); saref:resultTime indicates the time of joining.

models.name: ClusterLeave
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - ClusterLeave
models.description: Describes the act of a VRU cluster participant carrying out a procedure to leave a VRU cluster (s4auto:ClusterLeave, subclass of saref:ProcedureExecution). Linked to the cluster via saref:targets; saref:resultTime indicates the time of leaving and saref:hasResult the reason.

models.name: DangerousGoods
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - DangerousGoods
models.description: Kind of dangerous goods being carried by a heavy vehicle (s4auto:DangerousGoods). Narrower kinds are defined per the `class`/`division` definitions of part II, chapter 2.1.1.1 of the European Agreement concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous Goods by Road (ADR).

models.name: InductionLoopSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - InductionLoopSensor
models.description: The class of induction loop sensors (s4auto:InductionLoopSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: ItsAggregationSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - ItsAggregationSensor
models.description: The class of systems that aggregate information from other received its messages (s4auto:ItsAggregationSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: LidarSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - LidarSensor
models.description: The class of lidar sensors (s4auto:LidarSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: LocalAggregationSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - LocalAggregationSensor
models.description: The class of systems that aggregate information from different local sensors; aggregation may include fusion (s4auto:LocalAggregationSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: MonovideoSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - MonovideoSensor
models.description: The class of mono video sensors (s4auto:MonovideoSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: NightvisionSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - NightvisionSensor
models.description: The class of night vision sensors (s4auto:NightvisionSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: ParkingSpot
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - ParkingSpot
models.description: A location designated for parking (s4auto:ParkingSpot, subclass of s4auto:AutomotiveEntity). A parking spot is a geo:Feature and can thus have a geometry. NOTE: this name collides with the already-published dataModel.Parking.ParkingSpot; kept verbatim per SAREF4AUTO naming, see translation notes.

models.name: Platoon
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - Platoon
models.description: A platoon is a group of vehicles automatically following each other at a relatively close distance (s4auto:Platoon, subclass of s4auto:TrafficParticipant).

models.name: PlatoonBreakup
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - PlatoonBreakup
models.description: Describes the act of a platoon leader carrying out a procedure to break up a platoon (s4auto:PlatoonBreakup, subclass of saref:ProcedureExecution). Linked to the platoon via saref:targets; saref:resultTime indicates the time of breakup.

models.name: PlatoonJoin
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - PlatoonJoin
models.description: Describes the act of a vehicle carrying out a procedure to join a platoon (s4auto:PlatoonJoin, subclass of saref:ProcedureExecution). Linked to the joining vehicle (saref:madeBy) and to the platoon (saref:targets); saref:resultTime indicates the time of joining and OP saref:hasResultPosition the position where the vehicle joined.

models.name: PlatoonLeave
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - PlatoonLeave
models.description: Describes the act of a platoon participant carrying out a procedure to leave a platoon (s4auto:PlatoonLeave, subclass of saref:ProcedureExecution). Linked to the platoon via saref:targets; saref:resultTime indicates the time of leaving.

models.name: PmdSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - PmdSensor
models.description: The class of photonic mixing device (pmd) sensors (s4auto:PmdSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: RadarSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - RadarSensor
models.description: The class of radar sensors (s4auto:RadarSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: RoadSideActuator
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - RoadSideActuator
models.description: Devices deployed along the road that produce signals based on road side sensor data measurements, such as traffic light controllers changing from red to green based on detected vehicles (s4auto:RoadSideActuator, subclass of s4auto:RoadSideEquipment; restricted to control some s4auto:AutomotiveEntity via saref:controls).

models.name: RoadSideEquipment
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - RoadSideEquipment
models.description: A road side equipment can be either a simple data relay between vehicles and infrastructure or between vehicles themselves, or it can run applications. It is usually mounted high on existing equipment (street light, traffic light, VMS, highway sign) or on its own pole. Includes ITS-C road side units and other ITS field equipment such as traffic signal controllers (s4auto:RoadSideEquipment, subclass of s4auto:AutomotiveDevice).

models.name: RoadSideSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - RoadSideSensor
models.description: Sensors such as cameras or radars deployed along the road (e.g. at intersections and at poles along a highway) that perform measurements such as speed, position (relative or absolute), dimension, and direction of road objects (s4auto:RoadSideSensor, subclass of s4auto:RoadSideEquipment; restricted to observe some s4auto:AutomotiveEntity via saref:observes).

models.name: RoadSideUnit
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - RoadSideUnit
models.description: A transportation infrastructure communications device located on the roadside that provides V2X connectivity between On-Board Units/Mobile Units and other parts of the transportation infrastructure, including traffic control devices, traffic management systems, and back-office systems. Devices not part of the transportation infrastructure (e.g. cellular base stations or satellites) are not Road Side Units (s4auto:RoadSideUnit, subclass of s4auto:RoadSideEquipment).

models.name: SphericalCameraSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - SphericalCameraSensor
models.description: The class of spherical camera sensors (s4auto:SphericalCameraSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: StereovisionSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - StereovisionSensor
models.description: The class of stereo vision sensors (s4auto:StereovisionSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: TrafficEventCause
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - TrafficEventCause
models.description: Class of concepts describing traffic event causes (s4auto:TrafficEventCause, subclass of skos:Concept; adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 CauseCodeChoice/SubCauseCode). The vocabulary is large (161 named individuals in the v2.1.1 ontology: 20 top-level causes, each with several narrower sub-causes) and open-ended, so it is modeled here as an open/enumerated string rather than as ~160 separate data models (see translation notes). The 20 top-level causes are: TrafficCondition, Accident, Roadworks, Impassability, Aquaplaning, HumanPresenceOnTheRoad, WrongWayDriving, RescueAndRecoveryWorkInProgress, Violence, SlowVehicle, DangerousEndOfQueue, VehicleBreakdown, PostCrash, HumanProblem, StationaryVehicle, EmergencyVehicleApproaching, CollisionRisk, SignalViolation, DangerousSituation, RailwayLevelCrossing. Narrower causes follow the naming pattern '<TopLevelCause>_<narrowerCause>', e.g. 'Accident_accidentInvolvingBus' or 'TrafficCondition_trafficJamIncreasing'; see the full ETSI TS 103 410-7 / TS 102 894-2 specification for the exhaustive list.

models.name: TrafficEventObservation
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - TrafficEventObservation
models.description: Act of carrying out an observation resulting in a traffic event description (s4auto:TrafficEventObservation, subclass of saref:Observation). saref:hasResult links to the cause of the traffic event (TrafficEventCause); s4auto:affectsTrafficDirection links to the traffic direction the event affects.

models.name: TrafficLightController
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - TrafficLightController
models.description: A device that automatically operates coloured lights, typically red, amber and green, for controlling traffic at road junctions, pedestrian crossings and roundabouts (s4auto:TrafficLightController, subclass of s4auto:RoadSideActuator).

models.name: TrafficManagementCentre
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - TrafficManagementCentre
models.description: A traffic centre provides services to road users: exploiting data for road traffic management, providing information about mobility zones, operational management of the road infrastructure, etc. (s4auto:TrafficManagementCentre, subclass of s4auto:AutomotiveEntity).

models.name: TrafficParticipant
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - TrafficParticipant
models.description: Traffic participants include vehicles of different kinds, vulnerable road users such as pedestrians and cyclists, and road side units (s4auto:TrafficParticipant, subclass of s4auto:AutomotiveEntity).

models.name: Trailer
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - Trailer
models.description: Non-self-propelled vehicle that is designed and constructed to be towed by a power-driven vehicle, as defined in UNECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.4 class O (s4auto:Trailer, subclass of s4auto:Vehicle). Shares Vehicle's core positional/kinematic properties conceptually.

models.name: UltrasonicSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - UltrasonicSensor
models.description: The class of ultrasonic sensors (s4auto:UltrasonicSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: UwbSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - UwbSensor
models.description: The class of ultra-wide-band (uwb) sensors (s4auto:UwbSensor, subclass of saref:Sensor). Adapted from ETSI TS 102 894-2 - ITS Common Data Dictionary (CDD) V2.1.1: SensorType.

models.name: VRUCluster
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - VRUCluster
models.description: A Vulnerable Road User (VRU) cluster is a group of VRUs with homogeneous behaviour (see ETSI TS 103 300-2); VRU Awareness Messages (VAM) related to the cluster provide information about the entire cluster (s4auto:VRUCluster, subclass of s4auto:TrafficParticipant). Within a cluster, VRU devices take the role of leader (one per cluster) or member. A cluster is 'homogeneous' if it contains VRUs of only one profile, 'heterogeneous' otherwise.

models.name: Vehicle
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - Vehicle
models.description: Self-propelled transport device, along with any attachments (e.g. trailers), that is a legal user of the transportation network (s4auto:Vehicle, subclass of s4auto:TrafficParticipant; Source: ISO/TS 19091:2019). Examples of vehicle kinds are car, truck, public transport and two-wheeler. The main IoT device considered in the vehicle is the s4auto:OnBoardUnit (see AutomotiveDevice).

models.name: VulnerableRoadUser
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - VulnerableRoadUser
models.description: Archetype of vulnerable road users: non-motorized road users as well as users of VRU vehicles (L-class vehicles, e.g. mopeds or motorcycles) participating in road traffic (s4auto:VulnerableRoadUser, subclass of s4auto:TrafficParticipant).

title: SAREF4CITY (ETSI TS 103 410-4)
description: SAREF4CITY is an OWL-DL ontology that extends the ETSI SAREF (Smart Applications REFerence) core ontology for the Smart City domain. It was developed by ETSI STF 534 to provide a common core of general concepts for smart-city data oriented to IoT, covering administrative-area topology (countries, cities, districts, neighbourhoods and their containment relations), generic city objects (e.g. lampposts, buildings — typically co-typed with more specific extensions such as SAREF4BLDG or SAREF4ENVI), temporary/scheduled events and their accessibility, agents (persons, organizations, public administrations) and the public services they provide or use, and a Key Performance Indicator (KPI) pattern that separates a general KPI definition from its individual, timestamped assessments (e.g. "road congestion" as a KPI, and "70% congestion on road segment 50 at 13:30 on 2026-05-20" as one of its assessments). SAREF4CITY reuses seven other vocabularies (SAREF core, W3C Time, OGC GeoSPARQL/Simple Features, FOAF, W3C Org, DCMI Terms and W3C SKOS, plus the CPSV public service vocabulary) rather than redefining their concepts; this candidate translates only the 13 classes natively defined in the SAREF4CITY namespace (plus their 4 AdministrativeArea subclasses counted individually = 14 models), per the exhaustive-translation instructions for this pass.
publisher: ETSI (European Telecommunications Standards Institute) / SmartM2M Technical Committee
license: ETSI Software License (as declared by the ontology's dc:license annotation)

models.name: AccessibilityConcept
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - AccessibilityConcept
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/AccessibilityConcept. SKOS concept used to list the accessibility modes (e.g. metro, wheelchair access, hearing loop, sign-language interpretation) that can be linked to an Event via hasAccessibility. Subclass of skos:Concept (http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#Concept). SAREF4CITY defines no datatype property of its own for this class; its identity and meaning are carried entirely by its `id` (a URI identifying the specific accessibility mode, e.g. urn:ngsi-ld:AccessibilityConcept:metro), consistent with how the normative ETSI TS 103 410-4 worked example uses a bare individual (ex:metro) without any additional literal attribute.

models.name: AdministrativeArea
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - AdministrativeArea
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/AdministrativeArea. An administrative division, unit, entity, area or region, also referred to as a subnational entity, constituent unit, or country subdivision, delineated for the purpose of administration (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Administrative_division). Subclass of geo:Feature (http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature), itself a subclass of geo:SpatialObject, from which it inherits the topology pattern used throughout SAREF4CITY: a geospatial position (mapped here to the standard NGSI-LD `location` GeoProperty, derived from geo:hasGeometry) and the geo:sfContains / geo:sfWithin containment relationships used to connect an administrative area to the areas it spatially contains or is contained within (e.g. a city containing its neighbourhoods). City, Country, District and Neighbourhood are its four SAREF4CITY subclasses and are modelled as their own candidates, inheriting this same pattern without repeating it.

models.name: Agent
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - Agent
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/Agent. An agent making an action in the context of a city; an agent could be a person, software, organization, etc. Subclass of foaf:Agent (http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Agent), restricted so that cpsv:provides and cpsv:uses can only point to s4city:PublicService instances. A s4city:PublicAdministration (which is itself a subclass of org:Organization, not of Agent) is typically also typed as an Agent in instance data when it needs to provide or use public services, per the normative ETSI TS 103 410-4 worked example.

models.name: City
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - City
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/City. A city is a large human settlement, distinguished from other human settlements by its relatively great size, but also by its functions and its special symbolic status, which may be conferred by a central authority (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/City). Subclass of AdministrativeArea per the SAREF4CITY ontology, with no properties of its own beyond those inherited (location, sfContains, sfWithin); inherited properties are documented on the AdministrativeArea model and not repeated here.

models.name: CityObject
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - CityObject
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/CityObject. Generic class for describing city objects (e.g. a lamppost or a building). SAREF4CITY intends instances to typically be co-typed with a more specific domain extension (e.g. SAREF4ENVI for a lamppost, SAREF4BLDG for a building) that adds the object's own detailed properties; CityObject itself only contributes the generic identity and topology facets. Subclass of geo:Feature (http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature), from which it inherits the topology pattern used throughout SAREF4CITY: a geospatial position (mapped here to the standard NGSI-LD `location` GeoProperty, derived from geo:hasGeometry) and the geo:sfContains / geo:sfWithin containment relationships (e.g. a road segment feature containing a lamppost).

models.name: Country
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - Country
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/Country. A country is a region that is identified as a distinct national entity in political geography (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Country). Subclass of AdministrativeArea per the SAREF4CITY ontology, with no properties of its own beyond those inherited (location, sfContains, sfWithin); inherited properties are documented on the AdministrativeArea model and not repeated here.

models.name: District
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - District
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/District. A district is a type of administrative division that, in some countries, is managed by local government; districts vary greatly in size, spanning regions or counties, several municipalities, subdivisions of municipalities, school districts, or political districts (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/District). Subclass of AdministrativeArea per the SAREF4CITY ontology, with no properties of its own beyond those inherited (location, sfContains, sfWithin); inherited properties are documented on the AdministrativeArea model and not repeated here.

models.name: Event
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - Event
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/Event. Temporary and scheduled event, like a festival or competition (definition taken from Wikidata, https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q1656682). Restricted so that s4city:isOrganizedBy only ever points to a s4city:Agent (a person, organization, or public administration, since PublicAdministration instances are typically co-typed as Agent).

models.name: Facility
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - Facility
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/Facility. A place, amenity, or piece of equipment provided for a particular purpose (definition taken from https://en.oxforddictionaries.com/definition/facility). Used in SAREF4CITY as the place where an Event takes place (s4city:takesPlaceAtFacility) or a PublicService is involved (s4city:involvesFacility). Subclass of geo:Feature (http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature), from which it inherits the topology pattern used throughout SAREF4CITY: a geospatial position (mapped here to the standard NGSI-LD `location` GeoProperty, derived from geo:hasGeometry) and the geo:sfContains / geo:sfWithin containment relationships.

models.name: KeyPerformanceIndicator
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - KeyPerformanceIndicator
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/KeyPerformanceIndicator. A Key Performance Indicator (KPI) is a type of performance measurement; KPIs evaluate the success of an organization or of a particular activity in which it engages (definition taken from FIWARE, http://fiware-datamodels.readthedocs.io/en/latest/KeyPerformanceIndicator/doc/spec/index.html). This class holds the general, reusable definition of a KPI (e.g. 'road congestion'); its individual, timestamped values are represented separately as KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment entities, related to this one via s4city:quantifiesKPI.

models.name: KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment. The assessment of a KPI calculated by a given agent at a given time (e.g. '70% road congestion on road segment 50 at 13:30 on 2026-05-20'), as opposed to the general KPI definition held by the related KeyPerformanceIndicator entity. Note: saref4city.ttl declares `s4city:refersToFeature rdfs:domain s4city:KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment ; rdfs:range geo:Feature`, so `refersToFeature` is included here even though it is omitted from Table 4 of ETSI TS 103 410-4 clause 4.2.7 (the .ttl was treated as authoritative for this discrepancy).

models.name: Neighbourhood
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - Neighbourhood
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/Neighbourhood. A neighbourhood is a geographically localised community within a larger city, town, suburb or rural area (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neighbourhood). Subclass of AdministrativeArea per the SAREF4CITY ontology, with no properties of its own beyond those inherited (location, sfContains, sfWithin); inherited properties are documented on the AdministrativeArea model and not repeated here.

models.name: PublicAdministration
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - PublicAdministration
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/PublicAdministration. Public leadership of public affairs directly responsible for executive action (definition taken from Wikidata, https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q31728). Subclass of org:Organization (http://www.w3.org/ns/org#Organization) per the SAREF4CITY ontology, with no properties of its own. Note that org:Organization is not itself a subclass of s4city:Agent (it is a sibling branch under foaf:Agent), so a PublicAdministration instance does not automatically carry the cpsv:provides / cpsv:uses relationships; per the normative ETSI TS 103 410-4 worked example, instances that need to provide or use PublicService entities are additionally typed as s4city:Agent (see the Agent model) in the same way a single real-world entity (e.g. a city council) is simultaneously an Organization and an Agent.

models.name: PublicService
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - PublicService
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/PublicService. A service which is provided by government either directly (through the public sector) or by financing provision of services (definition taken from Wikipedia, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_service). Subclass and specialization of cpsv:PublicService (http://purl.org/vocab/cpsv#PublicService, from the ISA2 Core Public Service Vocabulary), restricted so that cpsv:physicallyAvailableAt only ever points to a s4city:AdministrativeArea and s4city:involvesFacility only ever points to a s4city:Facility.

title: SAREF4EHAW (SAREF extension for eHealth / Ageing Well)
description: SAREF4EHAW extends the SAREF (Smart Applications REFerence) core ontology to the eHealth and Ageing-Well / Active Assisted Living (AAL) vertical. It models the actors, devices and networks involved in remote health monitoring and ageing-well use cases: health actors (patients, users, caregivers, helpers, responsible parties) equipped with a Body Area Network (BAN) of health devices (sensors, actuators, wearables) connected through a BAN hub, communicating over communication interfaces/networks/protocols, and producing observation-collection executions (e.g. ECG recording sessions, SpO2/heart-rate/body-temperature readings). It reuses SAREF core (Device, Sensor, Actuator, Function, Command, Property, Service, State/StateValue), SAREF4SYST (System, Connection, ConnectionPoint) and SAREF4WEAR (WearableDevice) rather than re-defining them. This candidate translates the full set of SAREF4EHAW-own classes (21 classes) into one candidate model per class under models/.

models.name: Activity
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - Activity
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Activity. The activity of a patient/user, i.e. daily and nocturnal activities (ttl rdfs:comment). Superclass of DailyActivity and NocturnalActivity (both zero-own-property candidates that inherit activityDuration and velocity from here). Activity is the range of HealthActor.hasActivity.

models.name: Ban
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - Ban
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Ban. Body Area Network (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf s4syst:Connection, with a restriction that it connectsSystem some HealthDevice. A BAN is mainly used for collecting, aggregating and relaying patient/user vital parameters (ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.3). Ban is the range of HealthActor.usesBan.

models.name: BanApplicationTask
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - BanApplicationTask
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/BanApplicationTask. BAN application tasks, such as healthcare, telemedicine, assisted living, sport training, safety and emergency... models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - DailyActivity

models.name: FunctionalDevice
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - FunctionalDevice
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/FunctionalDevice. Functional Devices are non-purely eHealth/ageing-well devices that can be used for modelling/detecting activities or behaviours of patients/users, like for example beacons that can detect indoor positioning of a patient in a house (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf saref:Device directly (NOT HealthDevice). ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.5 states it 'shall thus have exactly the same object and data properties' as plain SAREF Device -- no SAREF4EHAW-specific properties are declared for it, and SAREF core's own Device properties are out of this candidate's 21-class scope (SAREF core itself is not part of this translation).

models.name: HealthActor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - HealthActor
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/HealthActor. The eHealth actors like e.g. caregivers, patients, users, helpers... (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf foaf:Agent. models.name: HealthActuator
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - HealthActuator
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/HealthActuator. Health-related Actuator, sub-class of SAREF Actuator (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf HealthDevice AND saref:Actuator (equivalence declared with SAREF core Actuator per ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.4: 'HealthSensor and HealthActuator classes are both equivalent to SAREF Sensor/Actuator ones. They will therefore not be described within clause 4.2.3... in order to reduce duplication with SAREF documentation, see ETSI TS 103 264 for details'). It therefore inherits every property of HealthDevice (serialNb, isAttachedTo, hasInterface, locationRelativeToBody, availableFlash, availableRam, remainingBatteryLevel, computingPower, powerSource, rechargeable, numberOfPowerSource, availablePowerLevel, dimensions, weight, sendingFrequency, precision, hasFunction -- see standards/saref4ehaw/models/HealthDevice/schema.json) plus SAREF core Actuator's own properties (out of this candidate's 21-class scope, since SAREF core itself is not part of this translation), with nothing of its own declared in the SAREF4EHAW ontology.

models.name: HealthDevice
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - HealthDevice
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/HealthDevice. Health devices, e.g. BAN hub, health sensor/actuator/wearable (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf saref:Device. Superclass of HealthActuator, HealthSensor, HealthWearable and BanHub, all zero-own-property candidates that inherit every property declared here. HealthDevice carries the bulk of device characteristics in this extension because the ttl defines most of them only as undomained saref:Property/saref:FeatureKind individuals (comments like 'of a device'/'of a feature of interest'), and HealthDevice is the most specific common class in this extension that is not itself a zero-own-property leaf class.

models.name: NocturnalActivity
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - NocturnalActivity

models.name: ObservationCollectionExecution
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - ObservationCollectionExecution
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/ObservationCollectionExecution. Execution consisting in collecting observations made by Device (e.g. Sensor, Wearable, ECG Device...) (ttl rdfs:comment). subClassOf saref:ProcedureExecution. Note: ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.3.2's worked ECG example additionally uses a closely related but differently-named s4ehaw:ObservationCollectionSession (not declared as a separate class in the published ttl) for a single recording session instance -- treated here as the same concept / a session instance of this class.

models.name: Patient
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - Patient
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Patient. A user of the type patient, i.e. a cared-for person by one or multiple caregivers (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf User (itself a subClassOf HealthActor). The source ttl declares no rdfs:domain property for Patient itself -- it is a pure specialization. It therefore inherits every property of User (hasHabit, hasImpairment, hasChronicDisease, posture) and, transitively, of HealthActor (firstName, lastName, dob, phone, hasMbox, gender, ageCategory, hasPhysicalLocation, usesBan, hasActivity) with nothing of its own declared in the source ontology. models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - ResponsibleParty

Modelled as a subClassOf HealthActor. The source ttl declares no rdfs:domain property for ResponsibleParty itself -- it is a pure specialization. It therefore inherits every property of HealthActor (firstName, lastName, dob, phone, hasMbox, gender, ageCategory, hasPhysicalLocation, usesBan, hasActivity) with nothing of its own declared in the source ontology.
