models.name: User
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - User
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/User. A health actor (patient included) that can be equiped with BANs or health devices for monitoring, control, care (specific case of patients) or support purposes (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf HealthActor; inherits firstName, lastName, dob, phone, hasMbox, gender, ageCategory, hasPhysicalLocation, usesBan and hasActivity from HealthActor (see standards/saref4ehaw/models/HealthActor/schema.json). Superclass of Patient, a zero-own-property candidate that inherits every property declared here (hasHabit, hasImpairment, hasChronicDisease, posture) with nothing of its own.

title: SAREF4ENER
description: SAREF4ENER is the SAREF (Smart Applications REFerence) ontology extension for the energy domain, standardized by ETSI as TS 103 410-1. It models the energy-flexibility capabilities that a smart device (an appliance, EV charger, heat pump, battery, PV inverter, etc.) can expose to a Customer Energy Manager (CEM), so that energy consumption/production can be (re-)scheduled without materially affecting user comfort. It harmonizes two previously separate industry data models -- EEBus/SPINE and the CENELEC EN 50491-12-2 "S2" standard -- into a single set of seven Flexibility Profile types (Power Profile, Power Limit, Demand Driven, Operation Mode, Fill Rate Based, Incentive Table Based, and Power Envelope), plus a Flexibility Communication layer (FlexRequest, FlexOffer, FlexibilityInstruction), a Load Control event/state model, and generic Data Point / Time Series constructs used throughout. This candidate translates every class defined in the SAREF4ENER v2.1.1 OWL ontology (77 classes) into one candidate model per class under models/, except for 16 pure controlled-vocabulary classes (e.g. Usage, IncentiveType, RoleType, InstructionStatus, EventActionConsume/Produce, EventStateConsume/Produce, PowerEnvelopeLimitType, PowerEnvelopeConsequenceType, PowerSequenceState, PowerSequenceStatus, PowerSource, ScopeType, ValueSource, ValueTendency) whose named-individual members are instead embedded as closed JSON Schema `enum` arrays on the referencing entity's own property, which is the standard Smart Data Models convention for OWL codelists that have no independent identity of their own.
publisher: ETSI (SmartM2M Technical Committee)

models.name: ActuatorLevel
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - ActuatorLevel
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/ActuatorLevel. Independent from the ActuatorSwitch class, the ActuatorLevel class enables a user or application to model LEVEL commands (start, up, percentageAbsolute, relative, etc.). This can be used to dim a light, set the speed of an electric motor, etc. Subclass of Actuator (https://saref.etsi.org/core/Actuator, not itself translated in this candidate).

models.name: ActuatorSwitch
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - ActuatorSwitch
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/ActuatorSwitch. Basic on/off operations on a simple actuator can be modelled with the ActuatorSwitch class. Whether the function turns a device itself ON or OFF, or whether it switches a specific feature, depends on the implementation. For example, one could model the super freeze program of a freezer using ActuatorSwitch class. An ON command would then activate the super freeze program and an OFF command would deactivate it. This example shall just give an idea how ActuatorSwitch can be used for more purposes than only turning devices on and off. Subclass of Actuator (https://saref.etsi.org/core/Actuator, not itself translated in this candidate).

models.name: AllowedLimitRange
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - AllowedLimitRange
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/AllowedLimitRange. The actual constraints of an Power Envelope Based Profile.

models.name: AlternativesGroup
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - AlternativesGroup
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/AlternativesGroup. A collection of power sequences for a certain profile

models.name: ContractualPowerLimit
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - ContractualPowerLimit
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/ContractualPowerLimit. The contractual power limit of a device Subclass of PowerLimit per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the PowerLimit model and not repeated here.

models.name: DDBCInstruction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - DDBCInstruction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/DDBCInstruction. An Instruction as specified for an Demand Driven Based Control Profile. Subclass of FlexibilityInstruction per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityInstruction model and not repeated here.

models.name: DataPoint
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - DataPoint
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/DataPoint. A data point is a quantity that is extended with various pieces of process information, namely - A creation time (instant). This is the point in time when the data point was created, which is not necessarily the time for which it is valid. In the case of soft-sensors or forecasters, a data point might have been created ahead of time, in the case of a direct observation a data point might created at its time of validity (or at the end of its validity time interval) and in the case of an archived value the data point might have been created after the fact. - A validity time (temporal entity) which will be named "time stamp". The validity time is the instant or interval in time in which a specific quantity is in effect. For example a room temperature might be measured at 12:00, which means it is in effect at this very instant. A specific amount of energy might me expended within the time-slot between 12:30 and 12:45, which means that the energy observation is in effect during this time interval. - A location or topological association. For example, an observation might be taken in a specific room, a power avarage might have been measured by a specific meter, a forecast might be valid for a specific region or grid segment. This association is therefore not always a location. Subclass of Observation (https://saref.etsi.org/core/Observation, not itself translated in this candidate).

models.name: DemandDrivenProfile
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - DemandDrivenProfile
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/DemandDrivenProfile. The Flexibility Profile following the Demand Driven strategy. Subclass of FlexibilityProfile per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityProfile model and not repeated here.

models.name: Device
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - Device
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/Device. A specialization of a saref:Device that exposes a power profile with power sequences to the CEM. Most of the existing devices can expose at most one power profile, but there are special cases in which more than one power profiles can be exposed by the same device. For example, consider the case of a combined fridge-freezer in which there are 2 logical devices (fridge and freezer) combined in 1 physical device. This combined device can expose 2 power profiles, one for the fridge and one for the freezer. A s4ee:Device (e.g. a household appliance or a smart meter) can also receive events about overload warning severity level and related load control commands (LoadControlEventData) Specializes saref:Device (core SAREF ontology, not itself translated in this candidate) with SAREF4ENER-specific properties.

models.name: EndInterruptionInstruction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - EndInterruptionInstruction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/EndInterruptionInstruction. An Instruction message indicating when an interruption can end. Subclass of InterruptionInstruction per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the InterruptionInstruction model and not repeated here.

models.name: EndTimeDurationDescription
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - EndTimeDurationDescription
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/EndTimeDurationDescription. The duration description for the end time duration temporal entities Subclass of DurationDescription (http://www.w3.org/2006/time#DurationDescription, not itself translated in this candidate).

models.name: EnergyConstraint
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - EnergyConstraint
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/EnergyConstraint. The energy constraint described in the Allowed Limit Range or Power Limit.

models.name: FRBCInstruction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FRBCInstruction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FRBCInstruction. A Fill Rate Based Instruction message. Subclass of FlexibilityInstruction per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityInstruction model and not repeated here.

models.name: FailsafePowerLimit
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FailsafePowerLimit
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FailsafePowerLimit. In case the communication between a device and the energy manager is interrupted, fail-safe values apply and the device enters fail-safe state until the communication is re-established. Subclass of PowerLimit per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the PowerLimit model and not repeated here.

models.name: FailsafeState
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FailsafeState
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FailsafeState. State that indicates that the device currently is in its Fail-safe state. This means that it has lost its connection to a central energy manager. This may result in the device following stricter power limits.

models.name: FillLevelTargetProfile
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FillLevelTargetProfile
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FillLevelTargetProfile. The target profile that a fill rate based control flexibility profile tries to follow. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

models.name: FillLevelTargetProfileElement
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FillLevelTargetProfileElement
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FillLevelTargetProfileElement. A description of the various Elements detailing the Fill Level Target Profile consists. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

models.name: FillRateProfile
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FillRateProfile
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FillRateProfile. A flexibility profile specified through a Fill Rate Based Profile. Subclass of FlexibilityProfile per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityProfile model and not repeated here.

models.name: FlexOffer
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FlexOffer
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FlexOffer. It allows to represent a flexibility offer (or schedule) as a combination of multiple time-series, data-points and forecasts. For example, we can create a flexibility offer that includes a time-series ex:T-power of power values, combined with a time-series ex:T-costs of associated costs.

models.name: FlexRequest
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FlexRequest
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FlexRequest. The flexibility request Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

models.name: FlexibilityInstruction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FlexibilityInstruction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FlexibilityInstruction. The various types of instructions Flexibility Sources can send and/or receive.

models.name: FlexibilityProfile
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FlexibilityProfile
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FlexibilityProfile. Different control types to describe the energy flexibility that a device has to offer. Charging of an EV for instance, may be controlled by power profile-based control or fill-rate -based control. It is not allowed to mix different control types at the same time, but different control types may be used sequentially. Control Types dictates flexibility instructions. Control Type provides Flexibility options. Subclass of Profile (https://saref.etsi.org/core/Profile, not itself translated in this candidate).

models.name: GaussianDataPoint
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - GaussianDataPoint
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/GaussianDataPoint. A data point whose quantity is a standard deviation. Subclass of DataPoint per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the DataPoint model and not repeated here.

models.name: Incentive
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - Incentive
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/Incentive. An Incentive indicates the intersection of a tier with a slot. In this particular combination of slot and tier there are a particular costs to draw this type of energy. For example, drawing power from the grid costs 0.30 euro per kilowatthour during the afternoon, but will only be activated from a lower boundary of 3000W. Subclass of DataPoint per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the DataPoint model and not repeated here.

models.name: IncentiveTableProfile
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - IncentiveTableProfile
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/IncentiveTableProfile. This flexibility profile describes the usage of an incentive table to describe an incentive type in the form of costs (relative or absolute), CO2 emissions or renewable energy percentage that can be associated to power values (expressed as a time-series of power data-points). Subclass of FlexibilityProfile per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityProfile model and not repeated here.

models.name: IncentiveTableSlot
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - IncentiveTableSlot

Each slot of the Incentive Table consists of a series of (lower) boundaries, each indicating the power at which a change to another incentive takes place. title: SAREF4ENVI
description: SAREF4ENVI is ETSI's SAREF extension for the environment domain (ETSI TS 103 410-2 V2.1.1), published by the SmartM2M technical committee. It extends SAREF Core (and reuses SAREF4SYST for connectivity) with two largely independent application areas: (1) a lighting/light-pollution domain -- light sources, light points, lampposts (including a shielded variant), and the photometer/TESS sky-brightness sensor kinds used to observe light properties such as illuminance, irradiance and light magnitude; and (2) a waste-management domain, itself organised into three chronological modules -- Waste (what is discarded, by whom, in what container, within what spatial perimeter: building, house, city, neighbourhood...), Collection (collection points, depots, itineraries, journeys, road segments and the vehicles that travel them), and Treatment (the organisations, sites, devices, tasks and functions involved in pre-treating, treating -- composting, anaerobic digestion, incineration with/without recovery -- and disposing of waste, landfilling included, plus the emissions, primary/secondary raw resources and final waste that result). This candidate translates the full v2.1.1 class list (66 owl:Class declarations in the s4envi namespace, verified by parsing the ontology's own Turtle file with rdflib) into one candidate model per real-world entity type under models/.
publisher: ETSI

Natural resource or energy that is used as a resource for the first time as input in a process or for creating a solution (source: ISO 59004:2024, clause 3.3.2). Subclass of s4envi:Resource (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.3.3.2.4); location is inherited from the Resource model and not repeated here.

models.name: ResidentialBuilding
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - ResidentialBuilding
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/ResidentialBuilding. Building for residential use. Subclass of s4envi:Building (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.5); all Building/Perimeter attributes are inherited, not repeated here. Base class for s4envi:House and s4envi:SharedResidentialBuilding.

models.name: Resource
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Resource
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Resource. Useful substances and objects. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.11); base class for s4envi:Waste, s4envi:PrimaryRawResource and s4envi:SecondaryRawResource, whose own models document only their own additional attributes and do not repeat location.

models.name: RoadSegment
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - RoadSegment
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/RoadSegment. Route taken by a waste collection vehicle between: (1) its depot and the first collection point on its round; (2) collection point n and collection point n+1 on its round; or (3) the last collection point on its round and a waste processing site. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.2.1.5).

models.name: SecondaryRawResource
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - SecondaryRawResource
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/SecondaryRawResource. Resource that is obtained from one that has already been processed or used (source: ISO 59004:2024, clause 3.3.5). Subclass of s4envi:Resource (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.3.3.2.5); location is inherited from the Resource model and not repeated here.

models.name: SharedResidentialBuilding
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - SharedResidentialBuilding
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/SharedResidentialBuilding. Building containing more than one dwelling. Subclass of s4envi:ResidentialBuilding (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.7); all attributes are inherited, not repeated here.

models.name: ShieldedLamppost
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - ShieldedLamppost
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/ShieldedLamppost. A lampost with a shield. Device kind in the Lighting Domain (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.1.4.2), broader device kind: s4envi:Lamppost (skos:broader -- NOT a formal OWL rdfs:subClassOf relationship in the ttl, so its full Lamppost-like attribute set is repeated here rather than inherited from the Lamppost model).

models.name: Sorter
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Sorter
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Sorter. Device that performs the task of sorting. Subclass of s4envi:WastePreTreatmentDevice (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.11); all WasteProcessingDevice attributes are inherited (via WastePreTreatmentDevice), not repeated here.

models.name: VermicompostBin
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - VermicompostBin
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/VermicompostBin. Device that performs the task of composting via vermicomposting. Subclass of s4envi:Composter; all attributes are inherited, not repeated here.

models.name: Waste
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Waste
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Waste. Substances or objects which are discarded, are intended to be discarded or are required to be discarded in accordance with national laws. Waste is a potential resource or commodity that could be turned into a useful product, recycled or recovered (source: ISO 24161:2022). See also envo:00002264. Subclass of s4envi:Resource (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.12); location is inherited from the Resource model and not repeated here.

models.name: WasteCollectionVehicle
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteCollectionVehicle
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteCollectionVehicle. Purpose-built vehicle for the collection and transport of waste, whereby the refuse is transferred by differential air pressure, a lifting device, mechanical means or hand (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.2.2.6). In the case of human-powered waste collection vehicles, they are not necessarily purpose-built for the collection and transport of waste. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.2.1.6).

models.name: WasteDisposalDevice
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteDisposalDevice
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteDisposalDevice. Device that disposes of waste. Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingDevice (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.5); all WasteProcessingDevice attributes are inherited, not repeated here.

models.name: WasteDisposalFunction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteDisposalFunction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteDisposalFunction. Represents the functionality of disposing of waste. Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingFunction (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.23).

models.name: WasteDisposalTask
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteDisposalTask
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteDisposalTask. Putting waste in an appropriate facility without the intention of recovery (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.1.3.3). Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingTask (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.19).

models.name: WastePreTreatmentDevice
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WastePreTreatmentDevice
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WastePreTreatmentDevice. Device that pre-treats waste before the waste undergoes treatment or disposal. Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingDevice (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.9); all WasteProcessingDevice attributes (location, directlyConsumes, indirectlyConsumes, directlyEmits, indirectlyEmits, produces, acceptedWasteKinds, yield, usesCommunicationInterface, usesCommunicationProtocol) are inherited and documented on that model, not repeated here.

models.name: WastePreTreatmentFunction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WastePreTreatmentFunction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WastePreTreatmentFunction. Represents the functionality of pre-treating waste. Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingFunction (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.24).

models.name: WastePreTreatmentTask
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WastePreTreatmentTask
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WastePreTreatmentTask. Represents the task of pre-treating waste: preparing waste for treatment or disposal. Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingTask (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.20).

models.name: WasteProcessingDevice
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingDevice
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingDevice. Device that processes waste. Subclass of saref:Device (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.4); top of the pre-treatment/treatment/disposal device hierarchy (WastePreTreatmentDevice, WasteTreatmentDevice, WasteDisposalDevice and their own subclasses), whose own models document only their own additional attributes (most have none) and inherit this model's attributes, including location.

models.name: WasteProcessingFunction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingFunction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingFunction. Represents the functionality of processing (pre-treating, treating, disposing of) waste. Subclass of saref:Function (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.22); saref:Function is SAREF Core, out of this candidate's scope. Base class for s4envi:WastePreTreatmentFunction, s4envi:WasteTreatmentFunction and s4envi:WasteDisposalFunction.

models.name: WasteProcessingOrganisation
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingOrganisation
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingOrganisation. Organisation in the waste processing industry that has waste processing sites. Subclass of org:Organisation (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.1); org:Organisation is out of this candidate's scope. No explicit object/datatype property is declared with this class as domain in the ontology (the 'has waste processing sites' relationship is descriptive prose only, not a formal OWL property), so no relationship is modelled here.

models.name: WasteProcessingSite
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingSite
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingSite. Licensed plant in which waste is treated in accordance with the local laws (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.1.3.20). Subclass of geo:Feature, org:Site and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.6).

models.name: WasteProcessingTask
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingTask
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingTask. Single step or a combination of multiple steps in which waste is handled via mechanical, chemical, thermal or biological processes with the aim of recovering material or energetic value and/or reducing the volume and environmental impact of the waste (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.1.3.19). Subclass of saref:Task (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.18); saref:Task is SAREF Core, out of this candidate's scope. Base class for s4envi:WastePreTreatmentTask, s4envi:WasteTreatmentTask and s4envi:WasteDisposalTask.

models.name: WasteProducer
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProducer
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProducer. Person or organisation which produces waste from their own activities (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.2.1.6). Subclass of foaf:Agent and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.13); foaf:Agent is out of this candidate's scope and carries no properties translated here. No location (not a geo:Feature).

models.name: WasteTreatmentDevice
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteTreatmentDevice
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteTreatmentDevice. Device that treats waste. Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingDevice (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.12); all WasteProcessingDevice attributes are inherited, not repeated here.

models.name: WasteTreatmentFunction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteTreatmentFunction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteTreatmentFunction. Represents the functionality of treating waste. Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingFunction (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.25).

models.name: WasteTreatmentTask
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteTreatmentTask
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteTreatmentTask. Represents the task of treating waste. Subclass of s4envi:WasteProcessingTask (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.21).

models.name: Windrow
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Windrow
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Windrow. Device that performs the task of composting via windrow composting. Subclass of s4envi:Composter (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.16); all attributes are inherited, not repeated here.

title: SAREF4GRID
description: SAREF4GRID is the SAREF (Smart Appliances REFerence ontology) extension for the smart grid domain, developed to describe smart electricity meters and the data/services they expose, explicitly aligned with DLMS/COSEM (IEC 62056) so that SAREF4GRID classes map cleanly onto real COSEM objects identified by OBIS codes. It covers: the core metering device (GridMeter, a subclass of saref:Meter) and its device-management components (Firmware, NetworkInterface, Clock with timezone/daylight-saving handling, BreakerState for remote connect/disconnect); tariff and billing automation (ActivityCalendar, SeasonProfile, DayProfile/RegularDayProfile/ SpecialDayProfile, DaySchedule, SpecialDayEntry, PresetAdjustingTime, ScriptTable, Script, SingleScheduledAction); generic data capture (ProfileGeneric, aligned with COSEM "profile generic" objects); power-line and meter measurement property kinds (EnergyAndPowerProperty, QualityProperty, MeterProperty -- each populated, in the source ontology, by a controlled set of named individuals such as ActiveEnergy, Voltage, Current, ReactivePower, DemandRegister, PowerLimit, and modelled here via a propertyType enum plus a SKOS-style broaderPropertyType field -- and PowerLine, the saref:FeatureOfInterest these properties are properties of); and the remote COSEM read/write/action service machinery (GetService, SetService, ActionService and their GetOperation/SetOperation/ ActionOperation, each with typed CosemOperationInput/GetOperationOutput subclasses and SelectiveAccess subclasses EntryDescriptor/RangeDescriptor). 40 own SAREF4GRID classes are translated; saref core classes it imports and subclasses (saref:Meter, saref:Service, saref:Operation, saref:State, saref:Property, saref:Function, saref:FeatureOfInterest, saref:PropertyValue, saref:Observation) and oneM2M classes it reuses (Device, Service, OperationInput, OperationOutput) are referenced in descriptions but not re-modelled as their own candidates here, since they belong to SAREF core / oneM2M, not to this extension.
publisher: ETSI
license: ETSI Forge Software License (https://forge.etsi.org/etsi-software-license), per the ontology's own dcterms:license statement

models.name: ActionOperation
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ActionOperation
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ActionOperation. This class is the means of an action service to communicate in a procedure-type manner over the network (i.e. transmit data to/from other devices). It is the machine-interpretable exposure of a human-understandable Command to a network. Subclass of saref:Operation (core SAREF). The specification's own worked examples (Figures 39-41) show an ActionOperation carrying a SimpleActionOperationInput or ComplexActionOperationInput, mirroring the hasInput pattern explicitly restricted (cardinality 1) on GetOperation/SetOperation; SAREF4GRID's OWL file does not carry an equivalent explicit local cardinality restriction for this particular class, but the relationship is included here for completeness since it is used identically in practice.

models.name: ActionService
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ActionService
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ActionService. This class is a representation of an action function to a network that makes the function discoverable, registerable, remotely controllable by other devices in the network. Actions can be performed over classes that are characterised by an OBIS code. Subclass of saref:Service (core SAREF).

models.name: ActivityCalendar
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ActivityCalendar
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ActivityCalendar. [COSEM] This class allows handling various tariff structures in the meter. This class provides a list of scheduled actions, following the classical way of calendar-based schedules by defining seasons, weeks, etc.

models.name: BreakerState
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - BreakerState
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/BreakerState. [COSEM] This class manages an internal or external disconnect unit of the meter (e.g. electricity breaker, gas valve) in order to connect or disconnect -- partly or entirely -- the premises of the consumer to / from the supply. Subclass of saref:State (core SAREF).

models.name: Clock
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - Clock
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/Clock. [COSEM] This class models the device clock, managing all information related to date and time including deviations of the local time to a generalized time reference (UTC) due to time zones and daylight-saving time schemes.

models.name: ComplexActionOperationInput
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ComplexActionOperationInput
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ComplexActionOperationInput. This class indicates that the parameter needed by the action to operate is complex (i.e. structure). Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here). SAREF4GRID further specializes this class as PresetAdjustingTime and SpecialDayEntry, each adding its own structure fields (documented on their own models).

models.name: CosemOperationInput
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - CosemOperationInput
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/CosemOperationInput. This class specifies the instance at which a service (get, set or action) is going to be executed by indicating the OBIS code. Subclass of oneM2M:OperationInput.

models.name: DayProfile
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - DayProfile
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/DayProfile. [COSEM] This class represents a list of scheduled actions which are defined by a script to be executed and the corresponding activation time.

models.name: DaySchedule
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - DaySchedule
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/DaySchedule. Scheduled actions to be executed at a given time for a day profile.

models.name: EnergyAndPowerProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - EnergyAndPowerProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/EnergyAndPowerProperty. Class to group those properties related to the energy and power of power lines. Subclass of saref:Property (core SAREF). SAREF4GRID does not aim to provide an exhaustive definition of all the properties defined in IEC 62056-6-2; instead it defines this set of general, named individual properties (listed in the propertyType enum below, e.g. s4grid:ActiveEnergy, s4grid:Voltage) and lets more specific, meter/OBIS-specific properties be related to them via SKOS (skos:broader/skos:narrower). This model represents one instance of such a (general or specific) property.

models.name: EntryDescriptor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - EntryDescriptor
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/EntryDescriptor. In the case of a get service of a profile generic class a selective access can be specified. This indicates the range of entries to be retrieved from the profile generic class. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own SelectiveAccess.

models.name: Firmware
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - Firmware
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/Firmware. [COSEM] This class holds identification information related to administration and maintenance of meters. They are not communication parameters but allow the device management.

models.name: GetOperation
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetOperation
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetOperation. This class is the means of a get service to communicate in a procedure-type manner over the network (i.e. transmit data to/from other devices). It is the machine-interpretable exposure of a human-understandable Command to a network. Subclass of saref:Operation (core SAREF).

models.name: GetOperationDataOutput
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetOperationDataOutput
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetOperationDataOutput. This class specifies that the output of a get operation is going to be a datatype. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own GetOperationOutput.

models.name: GetOperationObjectOutput
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetOperationObjectOutput
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetOperationObjectOutput. This class specifies that the output of a get operation is going to be a class. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own GetOperationOutput.

models.name: GetOperationOutput
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetOperationOutput
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetOperationOutput. This class specifies the output of a get operation, which can be either a class or a datatype. Subclass of oneM2M:OperationOutput. SAREF4GRID further specializes this class as GetOperationDataOutput and GetOperationObjectOutput (documented on their own models).

models.name: GetOperationPropertyInput
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetOperationPropertyInput
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetOperationPropertyInput. This class specifies the object/datatype property of an instance from which data is going to be retrieved by indicating the name of the object/datatype property. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

models.name: GetService
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetService
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetService. This class is a representation of a get function to a network that makes the function discoverable, registerable, remotely controllable by other devices in the network. Subclass of saref:Service (core SAREF).

models.name: GridMeter
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GridMeter
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GridMeter. Metering device that remotely records real electricity consumption. This device allows to control all the information regarding consumption for any time range, automatically and remotely. Subclass of saref:Meter (core SAREF); inherited saref:Meter/saref:Device properties (e.g. hasManufacturer, hasModel) are documented on the core SAREF Meter model and not repeated here.

models.name: MeterProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - MeterProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/MeterProperty. Class to group those properties related to electric grid meters. Subclass of saref:Property (core SAREF). Same general/specific-via-SKOS pattern as EnergyAndPowerProperty, scoped to meter (device-level, not power-line) properties; these are the properties a GridMeter links to via saref:hasPropertyValue.

models.name: NetworkInterface
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - NetworkInterface
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/NetworkInterface. [COSEM] This class holds the MAC address of the physical device (or, more generally, of a device or software). There shall be an instance of this class for each network interface of the physical device.

models.name: PowerLine
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - PowerLine
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/PowerLine. Interconnected network for electricity delivery from producers to consumers. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (core SAREF).

models.name: PresetAdjustingTime
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - PresetAdjustingTime
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/PresetAdjustingTime. This class represents the parameters that are needed by a clock to modify its time. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own ComplexActionOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

models.name: ProfileGeneric
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ProfileGeneric
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ProfileGeneric. [COSEM] This class provides a generalized concept allowing to store, sort and access data groups or data series, called capture objects. Capture objects are appropriate attributes or elements of (an) attribute(s) of COSEM objects. The capture objects are collected periodically or occasionally.

models.name: QualityProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - QualityProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/QualityProperty. Class to group those properties related to the quality of power lines. Subclass of saref:Property (core SAREF). Same general/specific-via-SKOS pattern as EnergyAndPowerProperty, scoped to power-quality properties.

models.name: RangeDescriptor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - RangeDescriptor
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/RangeDescriptor. In the case of a get service of a profile generic class a selective access can be specified. This indicates the range of values to be retrieved from the profile generic class. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own SelectiveAccess.

models.name: RegularDayProfile
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - RegularDayProfile
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/RegularDayProfile. This class represents normal dates. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own DayProfile; inherits hasDaySchedule (documented on the DayProfile model and not repeated here).

models.name: Script
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - Script
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/Script. [COSEM] Lists of actions to be executed by the meter. Subclass of saref:Function (core SAREF).

models.name: ScriptTable
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ScriptTable
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ScriptTable. This class allows modelling the triggering of a series of actions by executing scripts.

models.name: SeasonProfile
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SeasonProfile
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SeasonProfile. [COSEM] This class represents a season which is defined by its starting date and a specific day profile to be executed.

models.name: SelectiveAccess
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SelectiveAccess
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SelectiveAccess. The get operations property-related services typically reference the entire property. However, in the case of certain properties, selective access to only part of the property may be provided. Subclass of oneM2M:OperationInput. SAREF4GRID further specializes this class as EntryDescriptor and RangeDescriptor (documented on their own models).

models.name: SetOperation
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SetOperation
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SetOperation. This class is the means of a set service to communicate in a procedure-type manner over the network (i.e. transmit data to/from other devices). It is the machine-interpretable exposure of a human-understandable Command to a network. Subclass of saref:Operation (core SAREF).

models.name: SetOperationDataInput
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SetOperationDataInput
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SetOperationDataInput. This class specifies that just the range of a datatype property of the instance is going to be modified. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

models.name: SetOperationObisInput
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SetOperationObisInput
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SetOperationObisInput. This class specifies that the whole instance is going to be modified. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

models.name: SetOperationObjectInput
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SetOperationObjectInput
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SetOperationObjectInput. This class specifies that just the range of an object property of the instance is going to be modified. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

models.name: SetService
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SetService
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SetService. This class is a representation of a set function to a network that makes the function discoverable, registerable, remotely controllable by other devices in the network. Subclass of saref:Service (core SAREF).

models.name: SimpleActionOperationInput

models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SimpleActionOperationInput. This class indicates that the parameter needed by the action to operate is simple (i.e. integer, string, etc). Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

models.name: SingleScheduledAction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SingleScheduledAction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SingleScheduledAction. [COSEM] This class allows modelling the execution of periodic actions within a meter; such actions are not necessarily linked to tariffication.

models.name: SpecialDayEntry
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SpecialDayEntry
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SpecialDayEntry. This class represents the parameters that are needed by an activity calendar for adding a new special day. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own ComplexActionOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

models.name: SpecialDayProfile
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SpecialDayProfile
