Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own DayProfile; inherits hasDaySchedule (documented on the DayProfile model and not repeated here).

title: SAREF4INMA
description: SAREF4INMA is an OWL-DL extension of the SAREF (Smart Applications REFerence) ontology for the industry and manufacturing domain, published by ETSI as TS 103 410-5. It solves the lack of interoperability between different types of production equipment that produce items in a factory and, once items leave the factory, between the different organizations in a value chain that need to uniquely trace a produced item back to the corresponding production equipment, batch, material and precise time of manufacture. The ontology was created to align with Industry 4.0 initiatives (e.g. RAMI - Reference Architectural Model Industry 4.0) and reuses concepts from IEC 62264 (enterprise-control system integration) for its factory/site/area/work-center location hierarchy. SAREF4INMA extends SAREF with 21 classes, 16 object properties and 10 data type properties, and reuses (imports) the core SAREF and SAREF4BLDG (SAREF for buildings) ontologies rather than redefining their classes. This candidate translates all 21 classes defined directly in SAREF4INMA v2.1.1 into one model per class: Area, Batch, Factory, GTIN8ID, GTIN12ID, GTIN13ID, GTIN14ID, ID, IRDI, Item, ItemBatch, ItemCategory, MaterialBatch, MaterialCategory, ProductionEquipment, ProductionEquipmentCategory, ProductionEquipmentFunction, Site, Size, UUID and WorkCenter. Classes that SAREF4INMA merely reuses by importing other ontologies (e.g. saref:Device, saref:FeatureOfInterest, saref:Property, saref:Observation, saref:State, saref:Function from SAREF core; s4bldg:Building, s4bldg:BuildingSpace, s4bldg:PhysicalObject from SAREF4BLDG) are referenced from the relevant model's description/relationship target but are out of scope for this candidate set (they belong to their own ontologies' translations).
publisher: ETSI

models.name: Area
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Area
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Area . A subclass of the external s4bldg:BuildingSpace class (SAREF4BLDG), used to define the physical spaces of the building. According to IEC 62264, areas are physical, geographical or logical groupings of resources determined by the site. A site can be divided into areas, and areas contain work centers. Disjoint with s4inma:Site and s4inma:WorkCenter per the ontology's AllDisjointClasses axiom.

models.name: Batch
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Batch
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Batch . A uniform collection of tangible objects or Lot: either a collection of produced items (outflow of products) or a collection of raw material or required material (inflow of products). It is assumed the objects in a batch are similar and thus share attributes. Subclass of the external saref:FeatureOfInterest class (SAREF core). ItemBatch and MaterialBatch are its concrete SAREF4INMA subclasses; their own additional properties are documented on those models, while the properties below (declared directly on Batch) are inherited by both and not repeated there.

models.name: Factory
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Factory
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Factory . A subclass of the external s4bldg:Building class (SAREF4BLDG), specialized for SAREF4INMA: a factory represents one or more organizations sharing a definite mission, goals and objectives, which provides an output such as a product (definition taken from IEC 62264). A factory can be divided into one or multiple sites.

models.name: GTIN12ID
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - GTIN12ID
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/GTIN12ID . GTIN-12 (UPC-A) is a 12-digit number used primarily in North America. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasGTIN12IDValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

models.name: GTIN13ID
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - GTIN13ID
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/GTIN13ID . GTIN-13 (EAN/UCC-13) is a 13-digit number used predominately outside of North America. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasGTIN13IDValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

models.name: GTIN14ID
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - GTIN14ID
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/GTIN14ID . GTIN-14 (EAN/UCC-14 or ITF-14, also known as ITF Symbol, SCC-14, DUN-14, UPC Case Code, UPC Shipping Container Code, UCC Code 128, EAN Code 128) is a 14-digit number used to identify trade items at various packaging levels. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasGTIN14IDValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

models.name: GTIN8ID
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - GTIN8ID
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/GTIN8ID . GTIN-8 (EAN/UCC-8) is an 8-digit number used predominately outside of North America. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasGTIN8IDValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

models.name: ID
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ID
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ID . A unique identifier. s4inma:ID is a subclass of skos:ConceptScheme and the root of the SAREF4INMA identifier hierarchy; GTIN8ID, GTIN12ID, GTIN13ID, GTIN14ID, IRDI and UUID are its concrete subclasses, each adding its own more specific identifier-value property (documented on each of those models) instead of repeating hasIDValue.

models.name: IRDI
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - IRDI
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/IRDI . International Registration Data Identifier (IRDI), based on the international standards ISO/IEC 11179-6, ISO 29002 and ISO 6532, used in eCl@ss and the Asset Administration Shell as a unique identifier. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasIRDIValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

models.name: Item
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Item
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Item . A tangible object which can be uniquely identified, for example with a GTIN in the form of a barcode/QR/RFID tag. An item can be the result of an organization's production process (outflow of objects/goods) or a uniquely identifiable material (inflow of objects/supplies). Each item is created in exactly one ItemBatch, and can itself recursively consist of other items (sub-assemblies). Subclass of the external saref:FeatureOfInterest class (SAREF core).

models.name: ItemBatch
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ItemBatch
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ItemBatch . A uniform collection of tangible objects relevant for the production process, consisting of a set of objects with similar properties (e.g. a certain type of sensor or metal sheet). Unlike MaterialBatch, individual items can be traced within an ItemBatch (e.g. an individual metal sheet), because they carry a unique identifier (e.g. a GTIN code as a barcode/QR-code or RFID tag). Subclass of s4inma:Batch per the SAREF4INMA ontology; inherited properties (hasIdentifier, hasSize, needsEquipment, consistsOf) are documented on the Batch model and not repeated here.

models.name: ItemCategory
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ItemCategory
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ItemCategory . Describes a single type of item in terms of its static properties (e.g. a certain type of sensor). Each ItemCategory can have multiple related ItemBatches, which all contain individual Items whose essential properties are the same, even though small deviations between batches might occur because different batches can use different MaterialBatches and/or ProductionEquipment. An ItemCategory is produced by some ProductionEquipmentCategory.

models.name: MaterialBatch
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - MaterialBatch
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/MaterialBatch . A uniform collection of tangible raw material relevant for the production process: either a set of objects with similar properties (e.g. a certain type of screw) or a stock of homogeneous material (e.g. oil, water). Unlike ItemBatch, individual pieces of material cannot be traced within a MaterialBatch (e.g. it is not possible to trace the individual screw used). Subclass of s4inma:Batch per the SAREF4INMA ontology; inherited properties (hasIdentifier, hasSize, needsEquipment, consistsOf) are documented on the Batch model and not repeated here.

models.name: MaterialCategory
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - MaterialCategory
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/MaterialCategory . Describes a category of material in terms of its static properties, e.g. a certain category of steel or plastic. Each MaterialCategory can have multiple related MaterialBatches, which represent the physical material; essential properties of the material related to a MaterialCategory are similar across its batches, though small deviations might occur.

models.name: ProductionEquipment
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ProductionEquipment
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ProductionEquipment . A specialization of the external saref:Device and s4bldg:PhysicalObject classes that can produce items in a manufacturing process. Represents an individual production equipment machine and its specification in terms of functions, states and services. Concrete machine types (e.g. LaserCuttingMachine, MillingMachine, MouldingMachine, WeldingMachine) can be defined as needed as subclasses of this class; s4inma:WorkCenter is the one subclass already defined in SAREF4INMA itself (documented on its own model, which does not repeat the properties below).

models.name: ProductionEquipmentCategory
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ProductionEquipmentCategory
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ProductionEquipmentCategory . Represents a certain category of production equipment, generally static over time: concretely, a certain model and brand of production equipment. Each ProductionEquipmentCategory can have multiple related ProductionEquipment instances (the actual individual machines), and each ItemCategory can be produced by multiple ProductionEquipmentCategories.

models.name: ProductionEquipmentFunction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ProductionEquipmentFunction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ProductionEquipmentFunction . Functionality necessary to accomplish the task for which a production equipment is designed (e.g. a joining or cutting function). Subclass of the external saref:Function class (SAREF core); the SAREF4INMA ttl declares no own data/object property for this class, so it can be populated with further subclasses describing concrete functions depending on the use case.

models.name: Site
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Site
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Site . A subclass of the external s4bldg:BuildingSpace class (SAREF4BLDG), used to define the physical spaces of the building. According to IEC 62264, sites are identified physical, geographical and/or logical component groupings of a manufacturing enterprise. A factory can be divided into sites, which can in turn be divided into areas.

models.name: Size
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Size
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Size . The amount of certain objects in a collection (e.g. the size of a material batch). Subclass of the external saref:Property class (SAREF core, not redefined in this ontology file). The SAREF4INMA ttl does not itself declare a data property on Size; `value` and `unitCode` are included here, following the generic SAREF Property/Measurement value pattern, so that a Size instance is actually usable as the target of a Batch's hasSize relationship.

models.name: UUID
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - UUID
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/UUID . A universally unique identifier (UUID) is a 128-bit number used to identify items, also known as a globally unique identifier (GUID); documented in ISO/IEC 11578:1996 and ITU-T Rec. X.667 | ISO/IEC 9834-8:2005. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasUUIDValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

models.name: WorkCenter
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - WorkCenter
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/WorkCenter . A subclass of s4inma:ProductionEquipment (and therefore of the external s4bldg:PhysicalObject): an equipment element under an area in a role-based equipment hierarchy that performs production, storage or material movement (definition taken from IEC 62264). An Area contains work centers. Disjoint with s4inma:Area and s4inma:Site per the ontology's AllDisjointClasses axiom. Subclass of s4inma:ProductionEquipment per the SAREF4INMA ontology; inherited properties are documented on the ProductionEquipment model and not repeated here (the ttl declares no additional own property for WorkCenter).

title: SAREF4WATR
description: SAREF4WATR is the SAREF (Smart Applications REFerence ontology) extension for the water domain, developed by ETSI Specialist Task Force (STF) 566 and published as ETSI TS 103 410-10. It extends SAREF core (and reuses SAREF4SYST and SAREF4CITY) with a taxonomy of natural water bodies (Aquifer, Estuary, Glacier, Lagoon, Lake, Ocean, River, Sea), the generic Water feature-of-interest, water infrastructure (WaterInfrastructure and its subclasses DistributionSystem, StorageInfrastructure, MonitoringInfrastructure, GaugingStation, TreatmentPlant, HydroelectricPowerPlant), physical water assets (WaterAsset and its SinkAsset/SourceAsset/StorageAsset/TransportAsset/ WaterDevice branches: Channel, FireHydrant, Intake, Main, Manhole, Pipe, Pit, Pump, Reservoir, Tank, Valve, Vent), a water meter and tariff model (WaterMeter, Tariff, ConsumptionBasedTariff, ThresholdBasedTariff, TimeBasedTariff), and a set of property-grouping/controlled-vocabulary classes for water-quality, meter and flow measurements (AcceptabilityProperty, BacterialProperty, ChemicalProperty, EnvironmentalProperty, MicrobialProperty, WaterFlowProperty, WaterMeterProperty, WaterProperty, WaterKind, WaterUse). This candidate translates the full v2.1.1 class list (49 OWL classes) into one candidate model per class under models/.
publisher: ETSI

models.name: AcceptabilityProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - AcceptabilityProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/AcceptabilityProperty. An acceptability property is a property of water that is related to its acceptability. Subclass of WaterProperty per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterProperty model and not repeated here. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of Water.hasProperty): Colour, Conductivity, Hardness, HydrogenIonConcentration (label 'pH'), Odour, Oxidisability, Taste, Temperature, TotalIndicativeDose, TotalDissolvedSolids, TotalSuspendedSolids, Turbidity.

models.name: Aquifer
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Aquifer
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Aquifer. An aquifer is an underground layer of water-bearing permeable rock, rock fractures or unconsolidated materials. Subclass of StorageAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the StorageAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: BacterialProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - BacterialProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/BacterialProperty. A bacterial property is a property of water that is related to bacteria. Subclass of MicrobialProperty per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the MicrobialProperty model and not repeated here. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of Water.hasProperty): ClostridiumPerfringens, ColiformBacteria, ColonyCount22C (label 'Colony count at 22°C'), ColonyCount37C (label 'Colony count at 37°C'), Enterococci, EscherichiaColi (label 'E. coli'), PseudomonasAeruginosa.

models.name: Channel
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Channel
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Channel. A channel is a passage of water flowing in an open conduit (i.e., subject to atmospheric pressure). Subclass of Main (itself a subclass of TransportAsset and WaterAsset) per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the Main, TransportAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: ChemicalProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - ChemicalProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/ChemicalProperty. A chemical property is a property of water that is related to chemical components. Subclass of WaterProperty per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterProperty model and not repeated here. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of Water.hasProperty): Acrylamide, Aluminium, Ammonium, Antimony, Arsenic, Benzene, Benzoapyrene (label 'Benzo(a)pyrene'), Boron, Bromate, Cadmium, Chloride, Chromium, Copper, Cyanide, Epichlorohydrin, Fluoride, Iron, Lead, Manganese, Mercury, Nickel, Nitrate, Nitrite, Oxygen (labels 'Oxygen saturation'/'Dissolved oxygen'), PolycyclicAromaticHydrocarbons, Selenium, Sodium, Sulphate, Tetrachloroethene, TotalOrganicCarbon (label 'TOC'), Trichloroethene, Trihalomethanes, Tritium, VinylChloride, 12Dichloroethane (label '1,2-dichloroethane').

models.name: ConsumptionBasedTariff
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - ConsumptionBasedTariff
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/ConsumptionBasedTariff. A consumption-based tariff is a tariff that is based on consumption. Subclass of Tariff per the SAREF4WATR ontology; not a geo:Feature, so it has no location. Own properties: appliesTo, hasBillingPeriod, hasDuration, hasPeriod, hasBillingDate, hasStartTimestamp (repeated from Tariff), plus forFinancialConsumption, forVolumeConsumption.

models.name: DistributionSystem
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - DistributionSystem
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/DistributionSystem. A water distribution system is an infrastructure to carry potable water from a centralized treatment plant or wells to water consumers in order to adequately deliver water to satisfy residential, commercial, industrial and fire fighting requirements. Subclass of WaterInfrastructure per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties (including isDesignedFor and isIntendedFor) are documented on the WaterInfrastructure model and not repeated here.

models.name: EnvironmentalProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - EnvironmentalProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/EnvironmentalProperty. Class to group those properties related to the environment. Subclass of saref:Property (an imported SAREF core class, not separately modeled in this repository), with no properties of its own. Unlike the other SAREF4WATR property-grouping classes, EnvironmentalProperty is not referenced by any explicit OWL restriction in the ontology (no class has an allValuesFrom/someValuesFrom restriction pointing at it); it stands as general-purpose ambient/environmental controlled vocabulary, typically useful alongside GaugingStation/MonitoringInfrastructure/Water observations. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology: AtmosphericPressure, ExternalTemperature, Humidity, Precipitation.

models.name: Estuary
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Estuary
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Estuary. An estuary is a partially enclosed coastal body of brackish water with one or more rivers or streams flowing into it, and with a free connection to the open sea. Subclass of SinkAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the SinkAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: FireHydrant
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - FireHydrant
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/FireHydrant. A fire hydrant is a fitting in a street or other public place with a nozzle by which a fire hose may be attached to a water main. Subclass of WaterDevice (itself a subclass of WaterAsset and saref:Device) per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own beyond WaterDevice's 5 (hasFabricationNumber, hasFirmwareVersion, hasHardwareVersion, operatesAtRadioFrequency, requiresPower); inherited properties are documented on the WaterDevice and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: GaugingStation
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - GaugingStation
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/GaugingStation. A gauging station is an infrastructure to monitor and test terrestrial bodies of water. Subclass of MonitoringInfrastructure (itself a subclass of WaterInfrastructure) per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties (including isDesignedFor and isIntendedFor) are documented on the MonitoringInfrastructure and WaterInfrastructure models and not repeated here.

models.name: Glacier
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Glacier
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Glacier. A glacier is a persistent body of dense ice that is constantly moving under its own weight. Subclass of SourceAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the SourceAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: HydroelectricPowerPlant
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - HydroelectricPowerPlant
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/HydroelectricPowerPlant. A hydroelectric power plant is an infrastructure to generate electricity by conversion of the energy of running water. Subclass of WaterInfrastructure per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties (including isDesignedFor and isIntendedFor) are documented on the WaterInfrastructure model and not repeated here.

models.name: Intake
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Intake
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Intake. An intake is an installation for obtaining water from a source of supply (river, lake, reservoir, and so on). Subclass of TransportAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the TransportAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Lagoon
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Lagoon
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Lagoon. A lagoon is a shallow body of water separated from a larger body of water by barrier islands or reefs. Subclass of SourceAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the SourceAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Lake
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Lake
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Lake. A lake is an area filled with water, localized in a basin, surrounded by land, apart from any river or other outlet that serves to feed or drain the lake. Subclass of SourceAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the SourceAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Main
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Main
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Main. A main is a passage of water to flow through. Subclass of TransportAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the TransportAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here. Channel and Pipe subclass this class.

models.name: Manhole
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Manhole
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Manhole. A maintenance hole is an enclosure that facilitates human access to and working space for equipment (also labeled "Manhole"). Subclass of TransportAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the TransportAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: MicrobialProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - MicrobialProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/MicrobialProperty. A microbial property is a property of water that is related to microbes. Subclass of WaterProperty per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterProperty model and not repeated here. This class has no directly-typed individuals in the ontology; its only subclass, BacterialProperty, carries the microbial-property individuals (see the BacterialProperty model, also referenced via the Water.hasProperty enum).

models.name: MonitoringInfrastructure
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - MonitoringInfrastructure
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/MonitoringInfrastructure. A monitoring infrastructure is an infrastructure to monitor water. Subclass of WaterInfrastructure per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties (including isDesignedFor and isIntendedFor) are documented on the WaterInfrastructure model and not repeated here. GaugingStation (modeled separately) is a subclass of this class, not of WaterInfrastructure directly.

models.name: Ocean
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Ocean
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Ocean. An ocean is a large body of salt water. Subclass of SinkAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the SinkAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Pipe
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Pipe
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Pipe. A pipe is a passage of water flowing in a closed conduit (i.e., not subject to atmospheric pressure). Subclass of Main (itself a subclass of TransportAsset and WaterAsset) per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the Main, TransportAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Pit
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Pit
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Pit. A pit is a well or hole sunk in the ground to procure, store or drain water. Subclass of TransportAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the TransportAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Pump
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Pump
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Pump. A pump is a device for moving water by mechanical action. Subclass of WaterDevice and saref:Actuator (saref:Actuator imported, not separately modeled here) per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own beyond WaterDevice's 5 (hasFabricationNumber, hasFirmwareVersion, hasHardwareVersion, operatesAtRadioFrequency, requiresPower); inherited properties are documented on the WaterDevice and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Reservoir
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Reservoir
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Reservoir. A reservoir is an enlarged natural or artificial lake, pond or impoundment created using a dam or lock to store water. Subclass of StorageAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the StorageAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: River
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - River
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/River. A river is a natural flowing watercourse, usually freshwater, flowing towards an ocean, sea, lake or another river. Subclass of SinkAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the SinkAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Sea
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Sea
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Sea. A sea is a body of salt water partly or fully enclosed by land. Subclass of SinkAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the SinkAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: SinkAsset
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - SinkAsset
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/SinkAsset. A sink asset is a water asset where water sinks. Subclass of WaterAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterAsset model and not repeated here. Known subclasses in the ontology: Estuary, Ocean, River, Sea.

models.name: SourceAsset
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - SourceAsset
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/SourceAsset. A source asset is a water asset that is a natural source of water. Subclass of WaterAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterAsset model and not repeated here. Known subclasses in the ontology: Glacier, Lagoon, Lake.

models.name: StorageAsset
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - StorageAsset
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/StorageAsset. A storage asset is a water asset used to store water. Subclass of WaterAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterAsset model and not repeated here. Known subclasses in the ontology: Aquifer, Reservoir, Tank.

models.name: StorageInfrastructure
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - StorageInfrastructure
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/StorageInfrastructure. An storage infrastructure is an infrastructure to storage both potable water for consumption, and non potable water for use in agriculture. Subclass of WaterInfrastructure per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties (including isDesignedFor and isIntendedFor) are documented on the WaterInfrastructure model and not repeated here.

models.name: Tank
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Tank
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Tank. A tank is a container for storing water. Subclass of StorageAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the StorageAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Tariff
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Tariff
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Tariff. A tariff is a schedule of rates or charges of a business or a public utility. Tariffs can be based on time, thresholds or consumption; however, combined tariffs may also exist that mix more than one of these types. Root class (no explicit OWL parent other than owl:Thing); not a geo:Feature, so it has no location. This is the base schema for the Tariff family: ConsumptionBasedTariff, ThresholdBasedTariff and TimeBasedTariff all subclass Tariff and repeat these 6 properties plus their own additions. Own properties: appliesTo, hasBillingPeriod, hasDuration, hasPeriod, hasBillingDate, hasStartTimestamp.

models.name: ThresholdBasedTariff
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - ThresholdBasedTariff
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/ThresholdBasedTariff. A threshold-based tariff is a tariff that is based on a threshold. Subclass of Tariff per the SAREF4WATR ontology; not a geo:Feature, so it has no location. Own properties: appliesTo, hasBillingPeriod, hasDuration, hasPeriod, hasBillingDate, hasStartTimestamp (repeated from Tariff), plus forVolumeFlow.

models.name: TimeBasedTariff
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - TimeBasedTariff
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/TimeBasedTariff. A time-based tariff is a tariff that is based on time. Subclass of Tariff per the SAREF4WATR ontology; not a geo:Feature, so it has no location. Own properties: appliesTo, hasBillingPeriod, hasDuration, hasPeriod, hasBillingDate, hasStartTimestamp (repeated from Tariff), plus forAbsoluteTimeAtDay, forWeekDay, forDayInMonth.

models.name: TransportAsset
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - TransportAsset
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/TransportAsset. A transport asset is a water asset used to enable and support the transport and distribution of water. Subclass of WaterAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterAsset model and not repeated here. This is the root of the transport-asset hierarchy: Intake, Main, Manhole, Pit and Vent (plus Channel and Pipe, which subclass Main) inherit from this class.

models.name: TreatmentPlant
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - TreatmentPlant
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/TreatmentPlant. A treatment plant is an infrastructure to improve the quality of water to make it more acceptable for a specific end-use. Subclass of WaterInfrastructure per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties (including isDesignedFor and isIntendedFor) are documented on the WaterInfrastructure model and not repeated here.

models.name: Valve
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Valve
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Valve. A valve is a device designed to control water flow, pressure or volume. Subclass of WaterDevice and saref:Actuator (saref:Actuator imported, not separately modeled here) per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own beyond WaterDevice's 5 (hasFabricationNumber, hasFirmwareVersion, hasHardwareVersion, operatesAtRadioFrequency, requiresPower); inherited properties are documented on the WaterDevice and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Vent
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Vent
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Vent. A vent is the part of a system that allows air to enter a plumbing system to maintain proper air pressure and sewer gases to escape to the outside. Subclass of TransportAsset per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the TransportAsset and WaterAsset models and not repeated here.

models.name: Water
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Water
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Water. This class is used to define a particular quantity or body of water. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest per the SAREF4WATR ontology (imported class, not separately modeled here), restricted to saref:hasProperty allValuesFrom s4watr:WaterProperty. Own properties: hasProperty. The OWL class definition does not restrict Water to geo:Feature, but an optional location is added here as a practical addition beyond the strict OWL class definition, since a quantity of water is usually tied to a sampling point or body location.

models.name: WaterAsset
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterAsset
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterAsset. A water asset is a physical entity used in the process of transporting, treating, storing and distributing water. Subclass of geo:Feature, saref:FeatureOfInterest and s4syst:System per the SAREF4WATR ontology (imported classes, not separately modeled here). This is the root of the water-asset hierarchy: SinkAsset, SourceAsset, StorageAsset, TransportAsset and WaterDevice (and all of their leaf subclasses) inherit from this class. It has no own OWL properties beyond the base id/type/dateCreated/dateModified/source/dataProvider pattern plus location (inherited via geo:hasGeometry); this base+location pattern is documented here and not repeated on the subclass models.

models.name: WaterDevice
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterDevice
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterDevice. A water device is a device that is also a water asset. Subclass of WaterAsset and saref:Device per the SAREF4WATR ontology (saref:Device imported, not separately modeled here). This is the root device class: FireHydrant, Pump and Valve inherit these properties with no additions of their own, while WaterMeter adds further properties of its own. Own properties: hasFabricationNumber, hasFirmwareVersion, hasHardwareVersion, operatesAtRadioFrequency, requiresPower.

models.name: WaterFlowProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterFlowProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterFlowProperty. Class to group those properties related to water flow. Subclass of saref:Property (an imported SAREF core class, not separately modeled in this repository), with no properties of its own. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of WaterMeter.observes): FlowPressure, FlowRate, FlowTemperature, FlowVolume.

models.name: WaterInfrastructure
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterInfrastructure
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterInfrastructure. A water infrastructure is the set of facilities, services, and installations needed for water management. Subclass of geo:Feature, saref:FeatureOfInterest and s4syst:System per the SAREF4WATR ontology (imported classes, not separately modeled). This is the root of the SAREF4WATR infrastructure hierarchy: DistributionSystem, StorageInfrastructure, MonitoringInfrastructure (and its own subclass GaugingStation), TreatmentPlant and HydroelectricPowerPlant all subclass this class and inherit, without repeating, its base properties (id/type/dateCreated/dateModified/source/dataProvider/location) plus isDesignedFor and isIntendedFor. Own properties: isDesignedFor, isIntendedFor.

models.name: WaterKind
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterKind
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterKind. This class is used to define kinds of water features. Subclass of saref:FeatureKind (imported, not separately modeled here) per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own. Not a geo:Feature, so it has no location. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of WaterInfrastructure.isDesignedFor): DrinkingWater ("Drinking water is water that is treated to comply with drinking water standards.", also labeled "Potable water"), RawWater ("Raw water is water found in the environment that has not been treated and does not have any of its minerals, ions, particles, bacteria, or parasites removed."), Stormwater ("Stormwater is water that originates during precipitation events and snow/ice melt."), Wastewater ("Wastewater is water that has been used in the home, in a business, or as part of an industrial process.").

models.name: WaterMeter
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterMeter
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterMeter. A water meter is an instrument intended to measure continuously, memorize, and display the volume of water passing through the meter. Subclass of WaterDevice and saref:Meter (saref:Meter imported, not separately modeled here) per the SAREF4WATR ontology, restricted to saref:hasProperty allValuesFrom s4watr:WaterMeterProperty and saref:observes someValuesFrom s4watr:WaterFlowProperty. WaterMeter adds real restrictions beyond WaterDevice so it is given a full schema here rather than a bare stub. Own properties: hasFabricationNumber, hasFirmwareVersion, hasHardwareVersion, operatesAtRadioFrequency, requiresPower (repeated from WaterDevice), plus hasProperty, observes.

models.name: WaterMeterProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterMeterProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterMeterProperty. Class to group those properties related to water meters. Subclass of saref:Property (an imported SAREF core class, not separately modeled in this repository), with no properties of its own. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of WaterMeter.hasProperty): BatteryOperatingTime, BatteryRemainingTime, BatteryLastChange, MeterOnTime, MeterOperatingTime.

models.name: WaterProperty
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterProperty
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterProperty. Class to group those properties related to the water. Subclass of saref:Property (an imported SAREF core class, not separately modeled in this repository), with no properties of its own. This is the parent class of AcceptabilityProperty, ChemicalProperty, and MicrobialProperty (which in turn parents BacterialProperty); the union of all of their named individuals (54 in total) is exactly the controlled vocabulary used as the enum of Water.hasProperty. No individuals are typed directly as WaterProperty itself; see the AcceptabilityProperty, ChemicalProperty, MicrobialProperty, and BacterialProperty models for the full list of individuals grouped under this taxonomy.

models.name: WaterUse
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterUse
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterUse. This class is used to define the different uses of water. It is a root class in the SAREF4WATR ontology (no rdfs:subClassOf asserted), with no properties of its own. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of WaterInfrastructure.isIntendedFor): Agriculture ('Use of water for the farming of plants and livestock.'), Aquaculture ('Use of water for the farming of fish, crustaceans, molluscs, aquatic plants, algae, and other organisms.'), Domestic ('Use of water for domestic purposes.'), Industry ('Use of water for industrial purposes.'), Recreation ('Use of water for recreational purposes.').

title: SAREF4WEAR
description: SAREF4WEAR is the ETSI SAREF extension for the Wearables domain (ETSI TS 103 410-9), built on top of SAREF core, SAREF4SYST and SAREF4CITY. It models wearable devices (WearableDevice and its InBodyWearable / OnBodyWearable / NearBodyWearable / TextileBasedWearable / FabricWearable specializations, classified by their physical relationship to the body), the organisms and actors around them (LivingOrganism, Wearer, User, Software), detectable occurrences (Occurrence), the hardware components a wearable can be built from (Interface, PowerSupply, MemoryStorage, TextileBasedSensor), the policies a wearable follows (Policy), the functions a wearable can perform (CommunicatingFunction, ControllingFunction, NavigatingFunction, NotifyingFunction), and a classification of the kinds of properties relevant to the domain (wearable, wearer/biometric, electrical/electrical-safety, emission, environmental and crowd properties). This candidate translates the full v2.1.1 class list (29 classes) into one candidate per class under models/, except where explicitly consolidated -- see METHOD below.
publisher: ETSI

models.name: CommunicatingFunction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - CommunicatingFunction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/CommunicatingFunction. A function that allows a device to communicate with another device. Subclass of NotifyingFunction (itself a subclass of saref:EventFunction), per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.4). The ontology declares no own property for this class beyond the classification itself; communicationProtocol is added for a usable candidate model.

models.name: ControllingFunction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - ControllingFunction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/ControllingFunction. A function that allows a device to control another device (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.4), e.g. the audio-control wearable of TS 103 410-9 Figure 10 that controls a facility's speakers. Subclass of saref:Function. controlsDevice is added for a usable candidate model, grounded in the ontology's own example (saref:controls).

models.name: FabricWearable
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - FabricWearable
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/FabricWearable. A fabric wearable integrates its sensors directly into its fibers (e.g. a woven ECG shirt). Subclass of TextileBasedWearable per the SAREF4WEAR ontology. The source ontology declares no additional own data/object property for this subclass beyond the classification itself: all properties are documented on the TextileBasedWearable, OnBodyWearable and WearableDevice models and not repeated here (notably hasSensor, on WearableDevice, for the fibre-integrated sensors).

models.name: InBodyWearable
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - InBodyWearable
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/InBodyWearable. A wearable device located inside the physical body of its Wearer (e.g. an implanted continuous glucose monitor). Subclass of WearableDevice per the SAREF4WEAR ontology; inherited properties (dimensions, hasInterface, hasPowerSupply, etc.) are documented on the WearableDevice model and not repeated here. Its own defining axiom is the isLocatedIn relationship (a sub-property of WearableDevice.isLocated) to a Wearer.

models.name: Interface
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - Interface
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/Interface. The mechanism with which a device can receive or transmit data to another device (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.7). The SAREF4WEAR ontology defines this class only as the range of an object property (it declares no own datatype property); the attributes below are reasonable, minimal descriptive fields added for a usable candidate model and are not themselves drawn from explicit ontology axioms.

models.name: LivingOrganism
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - LivingOrganism
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/LivingOrganism. Any entity composed of cells; the generic SAREF4WEAR actor that can be equipped with a wearable device, before it is specifically known to be sensed by one (at which point it is more specifically a Wearer). Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.2). Covers humans as well as other organisms (e.g. livestock or pets fitted with animal wearables), which the ontology leaves open.

models.name: MemoryStorage
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - MemoryStorage
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/MemoryStorage. A hardware component intended to store data within the device (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.7). The SAREF4WEAR ontology defines this class only as the range of an object property (it declares no own datatype property); the attributes below are reasonable, minimal descriptive fields added for a usable candidate model and are not themselves drawn from explicit ontology axioms.

models.name: NavigatingFunction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - NavigatingFunction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/NavigatingFunction. A function that allows a device to provide navigation information (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.4). Subclass of saref:Function. The ontology declares no own property for this class beyond the classification itself; navigationMode is added for a usable candidate model.

models.name: NearBodyWearable
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - NearBodyWearable
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/NearBodyWearable. A wearable device located near (but not in direct contact with) the physical body of its Wearer (e.g. a smart badge on a lanyard). Subclass of WearableDevice per the SAREF4WEAR ontology; inherited properties are documented on the WearableDevice model and not repeated here. Its own defining axiom is the isLocatedNear relationship (a sub-property of WearableDevice.isLocated) to a Wearer.

models.name: NotifyingFunction
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - NotifyingFunction
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/NotifyingFunction. A function that allows a device to notify about some relevant activity, e.g. that a threshold value has been exceeded or that an object has moved (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.4). Subclass of saref:Function; parent of CommunicatingFunction. notificationTrigger is added for a usable candidate model, grounded in the ontology's own definition.

models.name: Occurrence
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - Occurrence
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/Occurrence. The fact of something existing or being found in a place, detectable by wearables (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.5), e.g. a queue detected by a crowd-control wearable (TS 103 410-9 Figure 9's ex:ToiletsQueue). Kept as its own standalone entity -- unlike the WearableProperty/WearerProperty/BiometricProperty/ElectricalProperty/ElectricalSafetyProperty/EmissionProperty/EnvironmentProperty/EnvironmentalProperty/CrowdProperty grouping classes, which were flattened into attributes of WearableDevice/Wearer -- because an Occurrence has real identity and structure of its own (a detecting device, a place, a time) rather than being merely the domain of a named measurement-kind individual; SAREF4CITY's s4city:Event is a documented subclass of this same class for city-scale occurrences. A 'name' attribute (not itself declared by the ontology) is added for readability, mirroring the descriptive individual names used in the ontology's own examples (ex:ToiletsQueue).

models.name: OnBodyWearable
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - OnBodyWearable
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/OnBodyWearable. A wearable device having direct contact with the physical body of its Wearer (e.g. a wristband). Subclass of WearableDevice per the SAREF4WEAR ontology; inherited properties are documented on the WearableDevice model and not repeated here. Its own defining axiom is the isLocatedOn relationship (a sub-property of WearableDevice.isLocated) to a Wearer. Parent of TextileBasedWearable.

models.name: Policy
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - Policy
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/Policy. A set of guidelines adopted during the wearable building process and defining how a wearable operates (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.3). The ontology declares no own datatype property for this class beyond the classification itself; name/policyDescription are added for a usable candidate model.

models.name: PowerSupply
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - PowerSupply
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/PowerSupply. A hardware component intended to plug a device to a power grid (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.7). The SAREF4WEAR ontology defines this class only as the range of an object property (it declares no own datatype property); the attributes below are reasonable, minimal descriptive fields added for a usable candidate model and are not themselves drawn from explicit ontology axioms.

models.name: Software
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - Software
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/Software. A computer program that can be linked with a wearable, especially for acquiring information (e.g. a companion smartphone app). Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.2). The ontology declares no own data/object property for this class beyond the classification itself.

models.name: TextileBasedSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - TextileBasedSensor
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/TextileBasedSensor. A sensor directly integrated into a textile artifact (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.7). Subclass of saref:Sensor per the SAREF4WEAR ontology. The SAREF4WEAR ontology defines this class only as the range of an object property (it declares no own datatype property); the attributes below are reasonable, minimal descriptive fields added for a usable candidate model and are not themselves drawn from explicit ontology axioms.

models.name: TextileBasedWearable
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - TextileBasedWearable
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/TextileBasedWearable. A wearable directly integrated into a textile artifact (e.g. a smart shirt). Subclass of OnBodyWearable per the SAREF4WEAR ontology. The source ontology declares no additional own data/object property for this subclass beyond the classification itself: all properties (isLocatedOn and everything inherited from WearableDevice) are documented on the OnBodyWearable and WearableDevice models and not repeated here. Parent of FabricWearable.

models.name: User
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - User
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/User. An entity using a wearable, defined as a saref:FeatureOfInterest for which an interactsWith relationship with a WearableDevice exists (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.2). Distinct from Wearer: a User interacts with a device (e.g. operating its controls) without necessarily being sensed by it, as in the audio-control-wearable example of TS 103 410-9 Figure 10.

models.name: WearableDevice
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - WearableDevice
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/WearableDevice. A device that is intended to be located near, on or in an organism (its Wearer). Abstract parent of InBodyWearable, OnBodyWearable, NearBodyWearable, TextileBasedWearable and FabricWearable. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:Device per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.3). The ontology's WearableProperty/ElectricalProperty/ElectricalSafetyProperty/EmissionProperty grouping classes, plus EnvironmentalProperty/CrowdProperty (measured by a wearable's environmental/crowd sensors per TS 103 410-9 Figures 6 and 9), are not modelled as separate top-level entities: per explicit translation instruction, each of their named-individual measurement kinds (BatteryRemainingTime, AcousticEmission, HeatEmission, RadioFrequencyEmission, AirQuality, SoundLevel, Temperature, CrowdSize, QueueSize) becomes a directly-named open-vocabulary attribute on this entity instead -- see standard-metadata.yaml for the full rationale. ElectricalSafetyProperty defines no named individual in SAREF4WEAR v2.1.1 and therefore yields no attribute here. hasSensor, measuresFeature and controlsFeature are declared in TS 103 410-9 Table 2 but not yet present in the published saref4wear.ttl v2.1.1 serialization; they are included here under the same s4wear namespace per the normative text.

models.name: Wearer
models.title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - Wearer
models.description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/Wearer. Any living organism that is sensed by a wearable device. Subclass of geo:SpatialObject and (LivingOrganism and isSensedBy some WearableDevice) per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.2). The ontology's WearerProperty/BiometricProperty grouping classes are not modelled as separate top-level entities: per explicit translation instruction, their named-individual measurement kinds (HeartRate, WearerTemperature) become directly-named open-vocabulary attributes on this entity instead -- see standard-metadata.yaml for the full rationale. The ontology itself notes (clause 4.2.6) that its list of named Property individuals 'does not aim to be exhaustive but to reflect the potential use of the ontology' (e.g. TS 103 410-9 Figure 8 instantiates an ad hoc ex:OxygenSaturation BiometricProperty not in the fixed individuals list), confirming this is meant as an open, extensible vocabulary rather than a closed enumeration.

title: Business Service extensions to the Federated ontology for SIMPLE
description: Extensions to the FEDeRATED project's Business Service ontology, created for the SIMPLE project to represent entities associated with business transactions, logistics services and legal persons in road and rail transport. Adds order types for Cargo Handling, Discharge, Gate-In, Gate-Out and Shunting, plus a Cargo Handling logistics service; specialises the location property of a logistics service into arrival/departure variants; relates Shipments to their constituent Consignments; and adds the eftiUid property for eFTI (electronic Freight Transport Information) / EU-Gate interoperability.
publisher: Ontology Engineering Group (OEG), Universidad Politécnica de Madrid -- ontology created in the context of the EU SIMPLE project; extends the FEDeRATED project's Business Service ontology (TNO)

title: Classifications extensions to the Federated ontology for SIMPLE
description: Extensions to the FEDeRATED project's Classifications ontology, created for the SIMPLE project. The Classifications ontology itself is a controlled-vocabulary / codelist module reused across the other FEDeRATED ontologies (LegalPerson, DigitalTwin, Location): a root Classifications class with subclasses for document types, cargo/container/package/ equipment types, dangerous goods and nature-of-cargo codes, transport modality and movement types, seal condition codes and TEN-T core network corridor names -- each populated with a small set of named-individual code values. SIMPLE's own extension document adds exactly one new code value: CMR (the international road consignment note) as a DocumentType.

title: Event extensions to the Federated ontology for SIMPLE
description: Extensions to the FEDeRATED project's Event ontology, created for the SIMPLE project to represent logistics events in road and rail transport not already covered by the upstream FEDeRATED taxonomy. title: Logistic Roles extensions to the Federated ontology for SIMPLE
description: Extensions to the FEDeRATED project's Logistic Roles ontology, created for the SIMPLE project. Unlike the sibling simple-federated-businessservice candidate (which owl:imports its FEDeRATED base ontology externally), this document is fully self-contained: it republishes the entire base FEDeRATED LogisticRoles taxonomy inline, under the base ontology's own ontology.tno.nl namespace, and adds exactly one new class of its own (simple-lr:Driver) plus two property redeclarations (:involves, :isAbout). The taxonomy covers two distinct role hierarchies: ActorRoles (roles a legal person can play in a business transaction -- Carrier, Consignee, Forwarder, etc.) and LocationRoles (roles a physical location can play in the context of a specific transport means and event -- PortOfLoading, PlaceOfDelivery, GateInLocation, etc.).

Modeled generically -- see the roleType property -- rather than as 17 separate entity types, since every concrete subclass (PlaceOfLoading, PortOfCall, PlaceOfDelivery, etc.) shares the exact same three required relationships and adds no property of its own beyond a differentiating label/comment.

NOTE: the SIMPLE ontology declares this class as rdfs:subClassOf the base ontology's pi:Location, but no class of that name exists anywhere in the base FEDeRATED PhysicalInfrastructure ontology (checked directly, including its last version before removal from the source repository) -- a dangling reference in the source document, not resolved by guesswork here. A handful of schema:Place-domain properties from the base ontology are still included below as optional, clearly-flagged additions, since SIMPLE's own Location is explicitly location-typed and the base ontology's own location-role/identifier properties target schema:Place -- but this is this candidate's own inference, not something the source document itself asserts.

title: TM Forum Open APIs (Product, Service and Resource Inventory, Trouble Ticket, Product Ordering)
description: The TM Forum Open APIs are a family of about 60 REST APIs for the telecom and digital-service industry, part of TM Forum's Open Digital Architecture (ODA). They are implemented by communication service providers and their IT vendors for ordering, inventory, assurance, billing, party and catalogue management. This candidate covers the inventory and assurance core: the product a customer holds (TMF637 Product), the services that realize it (TMF638 Service), the network, logical and physical resources that support those services (TMF639 Resource), the order that created it (TMF622 ProductOrder) and the trouble ticket raised when something goes wrong (TMF621 TroubleTicket). The sector is Telecom; the APIs are also used by other digital-service providers (utilities, cloud, smart-city operators).
publisher: TM Forum

title: UN Transparency Protocol (UNTP) - Digital Product Passport & Product
description: The UN Transparency Protocol (UNTP) Digital Product Passport (DPP) is a B2B data standard for carrying product and sustainability information through supply chains, issued as a W3C Verifiable Credential. This candidate translates two of its published entities -- DigitalProductPassport (the credential envelope) and Product (the credentialSubject / core product data model) -- into NGSI-LD/NGSI-v2 entities. Per explicit scope instruction, only these two entities are covered; other UNTP credential types (Digital Conformity Credential, Digital Facility Record, Digital Traceability Event, Digital Identity Anchor) are out of scope.
publisher: UN/CEFACT (United Nations Centre for Trade Facilitation and Electronic Business)
license: Not confirmed in this pass -- check the spec-untp repository's own LICENSE file before promoting this candidate out of Candidates/.

models.name: DigitalProductPassport
models.title: Smart Data Models - UNTP - DigitalProductPassport
models.description: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/untp/DigitalProductPassport . A digital Product Passport (DPP) credential. A W3C Verifiable Credential (VCDM 2.0) envelope whose credentialSubject is a Product (https://untp.unece.org/docs/specification/DigitalProductPassport/). In this candidate, the envelope (issuer, validity, credential status, render/issuing-software metadata) is kept as its own entity with a `product` Relationship to a separately-addressable Product entity, rather than inlining the full Product schema -- see standard-metadata.yaml.

Published standalone in the UNTP specification (artefacts/schema/v0.8.0/dpp/Product.json) independent of any specific credential wrapper; also used as the credentialSubject of a DigitalProductPassport (see the DigitalProductPassport model's `product` Relationship).
